Dialogue: "Why is your house much nicer than mine?" - Mulder

name: 14th Precinct House, Buffalo, NY

Dialogue: Mulder: "How'd you hear about us?"Det. Sharon Lazard: "My brother's a cop. Baltimore. He told me about your work on the Tooms case, said you gotta good feel for things out of the ordinary."

name: 1501, Larkspur Lane, Maryland

Dialogue: Mulder: "You don't believe in ghosts?"Scully: "That surprises you?"

name: A Bit of Light

Dialogue: "It's here! Here!" - Frank Briggs

name: A Call for Help
Text: Search through your Bureau deck for one Event or Witness card with Activator ACTIVE. Show the card to your opponent and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck. If the card is immediately playable, you may do so for zero [RP] cost.
Dialogue: "Whatever prompted her behavior, the fact remains that Scully is armed and obviously dangerous so I suggest you marshall whatever resources you have to make sure that you find her first." -  Skinner

name: A False Leads

name: A Final Choice
Text: Play this card to immediately move one opposing Agent to the Hospital. Place this card beneath the Agent and place five tokens on the Agent (seven tokens if played on Agent Mulder). Remove a token during the Agent's Healing Phase. When all tokens have been removed, discard this card. The Agent may leave the Hospital when all tokens have been removed.

name: A Friend In The FBI
Text: Play this card in the Bureau. Place ten tokens on this card. During your Briefing Phase you may take up to two tokens from this card and place them in your [RP] pool. The tokens become [RP] tokens. When all counters have been removed, discard this card.

name: A Friend In The Lab
Text: Play this card to search through your Bureau Deck and add any one Equipment card to your hand. Show your opponent which card you have added. Discard this card and shuffle your deck.

name: A Near Death Experience
Text: Play when Agent Fox Mulder is in combat. Assign all damage to Mulder first. After the combat, move Mulder to the Hospital with HEALTH zero. When Mulder leaves that Hospital, permanently add the following: +1 OCCULT INVESTIGATION, +1 ALIEN INVESTIGATION, +1 SCIENCES, +1 LONG RANGE COMBAT. Once per game you may ask an X-Files' identity without incurring a penalty question. Only one of this card may be in play.

name: A Privileged Mind
Text: Play this card to look at the top three cards of your Bureau deck. Then, you may place them back in any order.
Dialogue: "How you know what your opponent's going to do? You get inside his head. You read his thoughts." - Mulder

name: A Scully Family Gathering
Text: Play this card on a Team with Dana Scully to search through your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: "Margaret Scully", "Queequeg", "Melissa Scully", "Tara Scully", or "Father McCue". If you play the chosen card immediately, then you may do so for half cost (rounded up).
Dialogue: Dana Scully: "Look at you, my big brother."Bill Scully, Jr.: "Sorry, I'm late. My ship got stuck in traffic."

name: A war is never over
Text: Place this card on Agent Skinner. While Skinner is in the Field, he gains +1 RES and +1 LRC. Each player may have only one of this card in play.
Dialogue: "I was following orders, doing what my superiors commanded me to do. I'm not saying it's right. It's not. And I lived with the guilt of that decision every moment since." - Skinner

name: A Well-Placed Patsy
Text: Play this card when your opponent either uses a token or plays a card to negate your GOVERNMENT Adversary or Event. Discard one Witness card from your hand to negate the effect.
Dialogue: "No. No. No, sir. I won't be a patsy." - Lee Harvey Oswald

name: Abandoned Bus Terminal, Revere, MA

Dialogue: Skinner: "What do you got?"Scully: "Roche's old address in the area. Revere. 9809 Alice Road, apartment number six."Mulder: "He's there."

name: Abandoned Missile Site, Black Crow, North Dakota
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
Dialogue: Scully: "It's him Mulder, the man who shot my sister. He said he knows where Krycek is. I don't know if this makes any sense to you, he says he's headed towards an abandoned missile site somewhere in North Dakota." -  Scully

name: Adam Pierce

Dialogue: "I wish I could explain. Daniel and I, uh… I always played Salieri to his Mozart. I was never quite on his plane of intellect, but this time I found him slipping into madness, the way he began to control the others."

name: Additional Resources

name: Adversary's Rebirth

Dialogue: Scully: "Mulder, I don't know what you're getting at here. Regeneration of an entire body?. I don't know why I'm standing here listening to this."

name: Advice From a Loser
Text: Negate one EVOLUTIONARY Adversary. In addition, if the Team makes a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check 6+, they may ask either one MOTIVE or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: Eddie Van Blundht: "I just think it's funny. I was born a loser, but you're one by choice."Mulder: "On what do you base that astute assessment?"Van Blundht: "Experience. You should live a little. Treat yourself. God knows I would if I were you."

name: Agent Alex Krycek
Game Effect: He may choose to add to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resource Pool during his Briefing Phase.
Bio: Alex Krycek is a clean cut agent who professes an admiration for agent Mulder and his work on the X-Files. Krycek worked with Mulder in apprehending Augustus Cole (Sleepless) and in searching for Dana Scully after her abduction (Ascension). What no one else knows is that he is a double agent working for the Cigarette Smoking Man. He aided in the abduction of Scully, killed Mulder's father, attempted to kill Mulder (he shot Scully instead), and was present at Melissa Scully's murder.

name: Agent Ambrose Chapel
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Ambrose Chapel. Discard one token during any skill check to add 1 to Ambrose Chapel's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill. If Ambrose Chapel's Team is attacked by the Alien Bounty Hunter, Chapel may not participate in the Combat, but he may still contribute to the Site skill check.
Bio: Ambrose Chapel is an Agent that works for the Central Intelligence Agency (C.I.A.). He was impersonated by the Alien Bounty Hunter.

name: Agent Bill Patterson
Game Effect: Once per game, Agent Patterson may attack any Team investigating a Site as if he were an Adversary with the appropriate Activators. If a card is played that Negates him he is placed back into his controller's Field. If he is reduced to zero HEALTH, he is removed from the game.

name: Agent Bonnecaze
Game Effect: Place a token on Agent Bonnecaze. At any time during the game, discard a token to force any Agent to return to the Bureau immediately. This effect may not be used to interrupt Combat. An Agent moved in this manner may not contribute to any skill checks this turn.
Bio: Agent Bonnecaze was in charge of the Office of Professional Conduct's investigation into the death of Carina Sayles and the murder charges against Assistant Director Walter Skinner.

name: Agent Brian Fuller
Game Effect: When an Agent in Fuller's Team is forced to go to the Hospital, Agent Fuller may immediately elect to "escort" the Agent to the Hospital. Fuller may only do this if he would not normally be required to go to the Hospital himself. No other cards may be played on an Agent that Fuller escorts. This will prevent cards from being played on the escorted Agent.
Bio: Agent Brian Fuller was assigned to investigate the shooting of Assistant Director Walter Skinner by Luis Cardinal. Later, Fuller acted as a bodyguard for Skinner while he was hospitalized.

name: Agent Chester Desmond
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. You may discard that token to search your Bureau deck for an Equipment card with the MYSTIC Keyword. Add it to your hand, then reshuffle your Bureau deck.
Bio: hester Desmond was an FBI Special Agent and founding member of the Blue Rose Task Force. He investigated Teresa Banks' murder and mysteriously disappeared after finding a ring under a trailer, leading Dale Cooper to take over the case.

name: Agent Chesty Short
Game Effect: Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token during your Briefing Phase as Directed player to be able to purchase one additional card from your Bureau deck after the first purchase of cards. You must still pay for each card drawn this way.
Bio: Agent Chesty Short is a bureaucratic figure that criticizes Mulder and Scully's investigations' expense and efficacy. He doubts their belief in aliens and symbolizes the bureaucratic skepticism that often opposes Mulder and Scully's pursuit of the paranormal.

name: Agent Colquitt
Game Effect: FBI Agent Colquitt is responsible for managing prisoner transport and security, ensuring smooth transitions during transfers. He is involved when Scully arranges for Mulder to be escorted into a prison while handcuffed as part of a covert operation to infiltrate the facility.

name: Agent Craig Willmore
Game Effect: If Agent Craig Willmore is in the same Team as Agent Pendrell, Willmore gains a +1 to his COMPUTER and SCIENCES skills, and a -1 to his ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill.
Bio: Craig Willmore is a Special Agent for the FBI field office in Seattle, Washington. On April 2, 1996, he was assigned to investigate the disappearance of Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully.

name: Agent Dale Cooper
Game Effect: Place three tokens on Agent Dale Cooper. Once per turn, during a skill check, you may remove one token to add +1 to Agent Cooper's OBSERVATION, OCCULT INVESTIGATION, or SUBTERFUGE skill.
Bio: FBI profiler with uncanny intuition and dream-guided insights. Obsessed with coffee, truth, and inner balance, Cooper relies on sharp observational skills to uncover hidden clues, interpreting them through instinct, symbolism, and dreams. A brilliant mind navigating the unknown with calm precision.

Bio: Despite many strange cases, Dana Scully is resolute in her belief that science will lead her and Mulder to find the truth. When an inoperable cancer diagnosis forces her to overcome an existential crisis, Scully's allies endeavor to save her life at all costs.

Bio: Despite many strange cases, Dana Scully is resolute in her belief that science will lead her and Mulder to find the truth. When an inoperable cancer diagnosis forces her to overcome an existential crisis, Scully's allies endeavor to save her life at all costs.

Game Effect: Place 3 tokens on this card. Discard token to examine any one Bluff card. Place Bluff card back on the Site after examining.
Bio: Agent Dana Scully is a well respected agent who, at one time, taught at Quantico. She is trained in the areas of forensics and pathology and is highly skeptical of paranormal activity. Teamed with Mulder, she balances his theories with scientific reason.

name: Agent Danny Pendrell
Game Effect: Place three tokens on Agent Pendrell. During a skill check, discard one token to add 1 to Agent Pendrell's COMPUTER, SCIENCES, or MEDICAL skill.

name: Agent Diana Fowley
Game Effect: Agent Fowley allows you to choose to add to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resource Pool during the Briefing Phase. If Agent Fowley is in the same Team as Agent Dana Scully, both gain a -1 to their cumulative CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills.
Bio: As an FBI Special Agent, Diana Fowley investigated Gibson Praise with Agent Spender before joining Mulder's search for an Alien Hybrid. Despite her involvement, her motivations remained mysterious, leading to speculation about her ties to the Syndicate and her role with Mulder.

name: Agent Flagler
Game Effect: Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token during your Briefing Phase as Active player to be able to purchase one additional card from your Bureau deck after the first purchase of cards. You must still pay for each card drawn this way.
Bio: Agent Flagler is a meticulous investigator that analyzes evidence and handwriting samples for the FBI. Flagler's attention to detail contributed to unraveling a mysterious kidnapping case, collaborating with Mulder and Scully.

Bio: A highly skilled yet unconventional FBI Agent, Fox Mulder specializes in paranormal investigation. As a crisis of doubt threatens his belief in alien phenomena, Mulder begins to suspect that the man who raised him may not be his biological father.

Game Effect: [RP]s generated by Agent Mulder must be used to purchase cards. Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to play a Site for zero [RP] cost.
Bio: A highly skilled yet unconventional FBI Agent, Fox Mulder specializes in paranormal investigation. As a crisis of doubt threatens his belief in alien phenomena, Mulder begins to suspect that the man who raised him may not be his biological father.

name: Agent Fox Mulder
Game Effect: RPs generated by Mulder must be used to purchase cards. Place 3 tokens on this card. Discard a token to play a Site for 0 [RP] cost.
Bio: One of the FBI's most accomplished detectives, Fox Mulder uses his background in psychology to track down and profile a variety of serial killers. His real interest is paranormal phenomena, an obsession that earned him the nickname "Spooky".

name: Agent Frank Burst
Game Effect: Treat Agent Burst as a RES 2 if he is in the Field.
Bio: Agent Frank Burst was the first to capture the contract killer known as "Pusher". Burst called Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully to help apprehend him.

name: Agent Fred Nemhauser
Game Effect: Agent Nemhauser's BEHAVIORAL and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills are increased by one if he and Agent Patterson are on the same Team.

name: Agent Gene Crane
Game Effect: Agent Crane's BUREAUCRACY and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills are increased by one if he and Agent Doggett are on the same Team.
Bio: Special Agent Gene Crane worked under Deputy Director Alvin Kersh, assisting in key cases like the search for Mulder and the Zeus Genetics investigation. In late 2001, he was replaced by a super soldier, as part of an alien plot.

name: Agent Hedin
Game Effect: Agent Hedin has access to the Field Office Crime Lab. Place one token on this card. Remove a token to draw one Keyword EVIDENCE or EVIDENCE COLLECTION card from your Bureau Deck and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
Bio: Agent Hedin was assigned to the FBI Sci - Crime Lab in Washington, D.C. She matched fingerprints found in the American University stairwell to those of Pentagon employee Michael Kritschgau following his assault on Agent Scully.

name: Agent Hedin
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Agent Hedion. Discard one token to search through your Bureau deck and add any Keyword COMPUTER card to your hand. Show the card to your opponent and shuffle the deck.
Bio: Agent Hedin assisted in the investigation by matching fingerprints found on the stairwell to Michael Kritschgau, an employee of the Pentagon's research division, leading to a pivotal breakthrough in identifying Scully's attacker.

name: Agent Henderson

name: Agent Jeffrey Spender
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard a token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any on Keyword MOTIVE or RESULT Site card. Add that card to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau deck.
Bio: Jeffrey Frank Spender is the son of the Cigarette Smoking Man and Cassandra Spender, as well as the paternal half-brother of Agent Fox Mulder. He worked as a Special Agent in the FBI, assigned to the X-Files unit, partnered with Agent Diana Fowley.

name: Agent Jerry Lamana
Game Effect: Once per game, when Agent Lamana is part of a Team investigating a Site in the Investigation Phase, he may force his opponent to show the cards in his hand. Lamana may then steal any one card. He may use it immediately in the investigation. You must still pay for the card. Whether you use it or not, place it in its owner's Discard Pile at the end of the turn.

name: Agent John Doggett
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard a token to negate one Bluff. Additionally, if Agent Doggett is on the same Team as Agent Scully, change her Keyword SKEPTIC to BELIEVER.
Bio: Prior to joining the FBI, John Doggett served in both the U.S. Marines and the NYPD. Assigned to the X - Files in the wake of Agent Mulder's disappearance, Doggett's no - nonsense rationalism often put him at odds with Agent Scully.

name: Agent John Doggett
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard a token to negate one Bluff. Additionally, if Agent Doggett is on the same Team as Agent Scully, change her Keyword SKEPTIC to BELIEVER.
Bio: John Doggett is a no-nonsense Agent who frequently applies his down to earth sensibilities. A former a marine and NYPD detective, Doggett joined The X-Files, partnering with Dana Scully and later Monica Reyes, investigating unsolved cases with mysterious or supernatural elements. His son Luke Doggett was abducted and murdered.

name: Agent Kallenbrunner
Game Effect: Place one token on Agent Kallenbrunner. Discard this token to negate a Witness card played by your opponent. This token cannot be replaced.
Bio: A key prosecutor on Mulder's trial, Agent Kallenbrunner is a prominent figure within the Syndicate. He is skeptical of alien conspiracies and uses harsh tactics to discredit witnesses like Scully or Spender. His role reflects his commitment to upholding the government's cover-up and suppressing the truth'.

name: Agent Karen Kosseff, Counselor
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword BEHAVIORAL or OBSERVATION cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Karen Kosseff, Counselor
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword BEHAVIORAL or OBSERVATION cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Kautz
Game Effect: If Agent Kautz is in the Bureau, he may contribute to any EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check that is occurring in another section of the table.
Bio: As part of the FBI's Firearms Unit, Agent Kautz analyzed the ballistics of Agent Mulder's service weapon to prove he didn't murder his father ("Anasazi"). Kautz later ascertained the gun used to murder Detective Ray Thomas but indicated the serial number had been removed, rendering the weapon untraceable ("Zero Sum").

name: Agent Kreski
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Remove one token to negate a Keyword HEALING card played by your opponent.

name: Agent Krycek, Killed by Skinner

Dialogue: "It's going to take more bullets than you can… ever fire to win this game. But one bullet… and I can give you a thousand lives." - Alex Krycek

name: Agent Kyd Miller
Game Effect: Place one token on Miller's card. Discard a token to move Agent Miller from any Section to any other Section immediately, unless an Adversary has forced Combat. In that case, the movement occurs after the Combat is resolved. The Agent may join any Team in the new Section.
Bio: Agent Kyd Miller, an open-minded FBI Agent, aids Mulder and Scully in decoding mysteries involving terrorists, brainwave communication, and global conspiracies, while opposing the Cigarette Smoking Man.

name: Agent Lamana Dies In Fatal Elevator Accident
Text: If your opponent includes Agent Lamana in any skill check in the Field, Agent Lamana is instantly killed and removed from the game.

name: Agent Leyla Harrison
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION cards. If you spend this [RP], you may replace it during the Briefing Phase if Leyla Harrison is in the same Team as Agents Monica Reyes or John Doggett.
Bio: Leyla Harrison was an agent assigned to the FBI. She transitioned from the accounting office to the X-Files unit. Leyla admirably pieced together Mulder and Scully's adventures, later assisting Reyes and Doggett in their investigations.

name: Agent Linda Caleca
Game Effect: Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token to draw one card from the top of your Bureau deck for zero [RP] cost any time you are the active player.
Bio: Agent Linda Caleca was assigned to investigate the shooting of Assistant Director Walter Skinner. She identified the shooter as Luis Cardinal.

name: Agent Liz Einstein

Bio: Agent Kyd Miller, an open-minded FBI Agent, aids Mulder and Scully in decoding mysteries involving terrorists, brainwave communication, and global conspiracies, while opposing the Cigarette Smoking Man.

The escorted Agent may remove three additional points of damage while being accompanied during the next healing phase.
Dialogue: "I just wanted to make sure you got where you were going safely." - Scully

name: Agent Monica Reyes
Game Effect: If Agent Monica Reyes is in the Field, all Site cards with Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION may be played for 1 [RP] less.
Bio: Assigned to the X-Files alongside Agent John Doggett, Monica Reyes was initially skeptical but later embraced belief in the paranormal. She's characterized by her intuition, open-mindedness, and spiritual inclinations. Reyes' dynamic nature adds depth to the investigative team, balancing skepticism with a willingness to explore unexplained phenomena.

name: Agent Monica Reyes at Death's Door
Text: If your opponent includes Agent Monica Reyes in any skill check in the Field, the Agent is instantly killed and removed from the game. Your opponent may play the card Audrey Pauley to negate the effects of this card. Agent Monica Reyes takes no damage and Audrey Pauley is killed instead. Remove the Witness card from the game, whether it was already in play or not.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "They all think you're dead" – Audrey Pauley

name: Agent Mosley Drummy
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any one Equipment card that increases CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill. Add it to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau Deck.
Bio: FBI Agent Mosley Drummy led investigations, aiding in high-profile cases alongside Mulder and Scully. Known for skepticism, pivotal role in arrests, and leadership during crises. Involved in capturing notorious criminals, including modern-day Frankenstein Doctor.

name: Agent Murphy
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Agent Murphy. Once per turn, you may discard one token to force your opponent to remove one card (their choice) from their hand from the game.
Bio: Agent Murphy is a Department of Defense official tasked with overseeing classified projects, including genetic experiments like those in Founder's Mutation. Calculating and secretive, he safeguards government agendas at any cost.

name: Agent on Demand
Text: Search through your Bureau Deck and select an Agent with a Cost of 3 or less (X) and place it in the Bureau section. If this card is negated, remove it as well as the selected Agent from the game. During the Briefing Phase, pay X upkeep or discard this card and the selected Agent. Ignore Agent's Game Effect.
Dialogue: "Craig, it looks like we got some invited guests…" - Mulder

name: Agent Pathogen Treatment
Text: Play this card to negate any Keyword ALIEN MANIPULATION card or to heal 1 point of damage on any Agent in the Hospital.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "First Elder: "What good was that knowledge? Without the vaccine against the black oil, no one can survive."Well Manicured Man: "We have a vaccine. Developed by the Russians, stolen by Krycek, given to me."

name: Agent Peyton Ritter
Game Effect: Agent Peyton Ritter's BUREAUCRACY skill is increased by one if he and Deputy Alvin Kersh are on the same Team. If Agent Peyton Ritter is in the same Team as Agent Dana Scully, she loses one HEALTH.
Bio: Agent Peyton Ritter accompanied Scully to investigate Alfred Fellig, a crime scene photographer suspected of staging deaths. Ritter exhibited a single-minded focus on building a case against Fellig, disregarding Scully's cautious approach and revealing a dependency on the directives of his superior, Alvin Kersh.

name: Agent Phillip Jeffries
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Phillip Jeffries. Once per turn, during the Briefing phase, you may discard one token to double the RES value of any Agent in play (not in the Hospital). Add the additional RES to your Resource Pool.
Bio: FBI agent and Blue Rose director, Jeffries vanished in Buenos Aires. Obsessed with ‘Judy' and dark forces, he reappeared briefly before transforming into a non-corporeal, time-bending entity operating from a hidden location known as the Dutchman's.

name: Agent Reggie Purdue
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard this token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any one Site that asks a RESULT question. Add it to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau Deck.

name: Agent Reggie Purdue
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard this token and look through your Bureau deck to draw any one Site that asks a RESULT question. Add it to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau Deck.

name: Agent Reggie Purdue Found Strangled
Text: If your opponent includes Agent Purdue in any skill check in the Field, Agent Purdue is instantly killed and removed from the game.

name: Agent Rice
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Agent Rice. Any time during a Combat involving Agent Rice you may discard one token to search through your Bureau deck and add a Combat card to your hand. Show the card to your opponent and shuffle the deck.
Bio: Agent Rice led the SWAT response, coordinating with Scully during a hostage situation. Despite initial resistance, he contacted Mulder's captor, Gary Lambert, who demanded to broadcast a message, escalating the tense standoff.

name: Agent Rich
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION or SUBTERFUGE cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Rich
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION or SUBTERFUGE cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Roger Hardy
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard one token to choose one Agent controlled by an opponent. Add that Agent to Hardy's Team during one Site investigation. Afterward, return the Agent to the Team it belonged or to the Hospital if the Agent was reduced to 0 HEALTH during combat.
Bio: Roger Hardy was an FBI Internal Affairs agent who temporarily suspended Dale Cooper due to concerns about his actions in Canada. He questioned Cooper's conduct, requested his badge and gun, and informed him that the DEA and Canadian authorities would proceed.

name: Agent Sam Stanley
Game Effect: If Agent Sam Stanley is in the same Team as Agent Chester Desmond, they both gain a +1 to their cumulative MEDICAL skill, and a -1 to their OBSERVATION skill..
Bio: Sam Stanley, an FBI forensic pathologist, assisted Agent Chester Desmond in investigating Teresa Banks' murder. He discovered a key clue under her fingernail and transported the body to Portland. After Desmond's disappearance, Stanley suffered a personal breakdown.

name: Agent Sarah Sheherlis
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check.
Dialogue: Agent Sarah Sheherlis: " Which is why I thought I had your guy. Except I wasn't as lucky as I thought. So I ran the prints against the NCIC database."Scully: "Your message said that you identified them."Sheherlis: "Oh I did. Turns out it's one of our own people."

name: Agent Schoniger
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token to move Agent Dana Scully from anywhere on the table to the Team Agent Schoniger is in. Scully may assist in any skill check made by the team. In this manner, Scully may assist on two Sites in one turn.
Bio: Agent Schoniger, with 30 years of FBI experience, assists Scully in analyzing Mulder's hypnosis tape about Samantha's abduction, attributing Mulder's memories to compensatory fantasy, and believes Samantha was likely killed in 1973.

name: Agent Tammy Preston
Game Effect: Agent Tammy Preston's BUREAUCRACY and OCCULT INVESTIGATION skills are increased by one if he Deputy Director Gordon Cole are on the same Team.
Bio: Tamara "Tammy" Preston is a brilliant FBI agent recruited into the Blue Rose Task Force. She investigated Agent Dale Cooper's return, analyzed paranormal dossiers, and uncovered timeline anomalies. Her sharp insight and loyalty to Gordon Cole defined her pivotal role in Twin Peaks.

name: Agent Thomas
Game Effect: Place a [RP] token on this card. This may be used to pay for for any CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or BEHAVIORAL cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your briefing phase.
Bio: Agent Thomas helped FBI agents Mulder and Scully to find traces that lead them to Lucas Henry, by showing Liz Hawley, a series of Polaroid photographs of a possible suspect.

name: Agent Tom Colton
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Agent Tom Colton

name: Agent Weiss Killed By Unknown Toxin
Text: If your opponent includes Agent Weiss in any skill check in the Field, Agent Weiss is instantly killed and removed from the game.

name: Agent's Verschwinden
Text: Select one Agent from the Team investigating this Site. That Agent, along with any attached cards, is placed face-up, twelve cards down, in the owning player's Bureau deck. When the Agent's card reaches the top of the deck, the Agent (and any attached cards) are immediately moved to the Field, undamaged.
Dialogue: "Why? Why me, Gerry? Do I remind you of your sister? Why did your sister kill herself, Gerry?" - Scully

name: Agents in the Hospital
Text: Play this card when there are two or more Agents in the Hospital. No Agents in the Hospital may heal any damage this turn.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Guess I'm not dead."Scully: "What happened?"Mulder: "Maybe you can tell me?"Scully: "The State police found you unconscious. You were strapped in the passenger's seat of a rental car that had been driven into a ditch."

name: Agents' Recharge
Text: Play this card at the beginning of the Case Assignment or the Investigation phases to get an additional Healing phase this turn. After that extra phase, go directly to the Debriefing phase. Remove this card from the game.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "I'm taking a bubble bath." - Skinner

name: Aggressive Recall Therapy
Text: Attach this card to one of your Agents to apply a -1 modifier to the Agent's HEALTH. While this Agent is in the Field, your opponent must randomly reveal one card in their hand, once per turn. When this Resource is discarded, the Agent's HEALTH is restored.
Dialogue: "Whatever's happening to me, whatever treatment I've received, is allowing me to go back into my unconscious. The truth is in there, recorded, and I've gotten access to it." - Mulder

name: Air Traffic Controller
Text: Once during your Briefing Phase look at the top card of your Bureau Deck. You may put that card on the bottom of your Bureau Deck.

name: Airlift
Text: Play on a Team during the Deployment Phase. If the Team makes an ALIEN INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check, they may investigate two Sites in either the same state or neighboring states this turn.
Dialogue: "Someone used Krycek, then Krycek used us. Someone who didn't want that rock in American hands." - Mulder

name: Albert Hosteen
Game Effect: Place a token on Hosteen's card. Discard a token to examine your opponent's hand. Select any one Conspiracy card in your opponent's hand show it to your opponent. If your opponent plays that card at any time in the game, you may immediately ask one question about the X-File. This question may only be asked the first time the card is played.

name: Albert Hosteen
Game Effect: Place a token on Hosteen's card. Discard a token to examine your opponent's hand. Select any one Conspiracy card in your opponent's hand show it to your opponent. If your opponent plays that card at any time in the game, you may immediately ask one question about the X-File. This question may only be asked the first time the card is played.

name: Albert Hosteen
Game Effect: Place a token on Hosteen's card. Discard a token to examine your opponent's hand. Select any one Conspiracy card. If your opponent plays that card at any time in the game, you may immediately ask one question about the X‐File. This question may only be asked the first time the card is played.
Bio: Albert Hosteen is a Navajo Tribal Elder. He met and assisted Agent Mulder during the events depicted in "Anasazi", "The Blessing Way", and "Paper Clip". He performed a ritual that helped Mulder survive injuries inflicted on him by the Cigarette Smoking Man.

name: Aleister Crowley High School, Milford Haven, NH
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION or one RESULT question.

name: Aleister Crowley High School, Milford Haven, NH

name: Alfred Fellig
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. Alternately, any card that would send Dana Scully to the Hospital may be negated by playing this card. If played this way, remove Alfred Fellig from the game. This card cannot be played during a Combat and it is not a Healing card.
Dialogue: "Do you see him? Don't look. Close your eyes…" - Alfred Fellig

name: Alien Abduction
Text: Force a Team in the Field to make an ALIEN INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check. If they fail, attach this card to any Agent in that Team (your choice) and remove the Agent from play. During the next Agent's controller Healing phase, move the Agent to the Hospital (undamaged).
Dialogue: "Agent Mulder?! Mulder!" - Skinner

name: Alien Autopsy Video
Text: Discard this card to add three to the Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill.

name: Alien Body Is A Hoax
Text: Play this card to change the question(s) listed on one Site card to METHOD.
Dialogue: Blaine Faulkner: "You mean it's… it's just a dead human being?"Detective Manners: "Well then who is this bleep?"Mulder: "I don't know, but I bet we can find his I.D. from the military database."

name: Alien Bounty Healer
Text: Play on an Agent in the Hospital. The Agent heals up to three tokens of damage and any afflicting Keywords (i.e. CANCER, INSANITY) are removed.
Dialogue: Alien Bounty Hunter: "I need to know the reasons why this should be."The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "So that the work may continue. So that the project may proceed unabated by removing an unnecessary obstacle."

name: Alien Bounty Hunter
Text: Each source of damage affecting the Alien Bounty Hunter in CLOSE RANGE COMBAT also causes 1 damage to each opposing Team member involved in the Combat (because he has poisonous blood). The Hunter may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE Combat cards. If killed in Combat, place the Hunter back in your deck and shuffle.

name: Alien Bounty Hunter
Text: Each source of damage affecting the Alien Bounty Hunter in CLOSE RANGE COMBAT also causes 1 damage to each opposing Team member involved in the Combat (because he has poisonous blood). The Hunter may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE Combat cards. If killed in Combat, place the Hunter back in your deck and shuffle.

name: Alien Death Grip
Text: Play on any Adversary to add 1 to its CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill check. In addition, if the Adversary is ALIEN, play on the chosen Agent in Combat to negate their combat skills this round.
Dialogue: Alien Bounty Hunter: "Where are they going?"Scully (gasping for air): "Uh...I don't know."Alien Bounty Hunter: "I need to know."

name: Alien Discretion
Text: Play on a Team about to investigate a Site with ALIEN INVESTIGATION as a prerequisite. Discard all cards assigned as Bluff cards at that Site. X = the number of Bluffs at the Site.

name: Alien Discretion
Text: Play on a Team about to investigate a Site with ALIEN INVESTIGATION as a prerequisite. Discard all cards assigned as Bluff cards at that Site. X = the number of Bluffs at the Site.

name: Alien DNA Drain
Text: You may discard any number of cards from your hand to force your opponent to discard the same cards from their hand (opponent's choice).
Dialogue: "You see, the alien fetus would give us the alien genome… the DNA with which we could make a human hybrid. A new race, Agent Mulder." - The Cigarette Smoking Man

name: Alien Dna Steroid Program (project Purity Control)
Alien Dna Steroid Program (project Purity Control)
Alien Experience
Text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one Keyword ALIEN Adversary.
Dialogue: Jose Chung: "Have I had my share of mornings like that. Oh, but these have the characteristics of someone who has… uh… do you prefer the term 'abductee' or 'experiencer'?"Scully: "Actually, I prefer neither, but my partner uses 'abductee'."

name: Alien Experience [alternate version]
Text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one Keyword ALIEN Adversary.
Dialogue: Alien #1: "Jack, what is that thing?"Alien #2: "How the hell should I know?"

name: Alien Experimentation
Text: Negate any one Keyword Event card.
Dialogue: Mulder: "They take you aboard the ship to perform the tests."Duane Barry: "They drill holes in my teeth. They drill holes in my damn teeth!"

name: Alien Harvester
Text: Your opponent may not spread out Agents until this card is resolved. Hold this card twelve inches up and twelve inches away from the opponent's Team. Flip the card so that it spins through the air. All of the Agents in the Investigating Team that are being touched by the Alien Harvester are abducted! Discard any Equipment attached to the abducted Agents. The Agents are placed ten cards down, face up, in the Bureau deck. When the Agent cards reach the top of the deck, the Agents are immediately moved to the Hospital (though they are not damaged).

name: Alien Relic Unveiled
Text: Play on one Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any one ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SCIENCES skill check.
Dialogue: "Yes, get me the international operator, please. I need to place a call to the United States." - Dr. Merkmallen

name: Alien Spider Host
Text: Attach the Alien Spider to an Agent in a Team of two or more Agents. That Agent becomes aggressive and attacks their own Team sequentially, one by one (your choice). Then the infected Agent moves on to the next Agent, until all Agents are defeated or until he is sent to the Hospital. Discard this card afterwards.
Dialogue: "I'm dead, too, inside, because of this thing they put in me. For what? To turn me into some kind of killing machine, or just to see what would happen?" - Edward Skur

name: Alien Stealth Technology
Text: Play on any ALIEN combatant to reduce damage from all opponent LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT sources by 1 this round.

name: Alien Stealth Technology
Text: Play on any ALIEN combatant to reduce damage from all opponent LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT sources by 1 this round.

name: Alien Stiletto
Text: Attach this Equipment to any Agent in the Field. Any ALIEN Adversary damaged by this weapon in CLOSE RANGE COMBAT is discarded prior to dealing damage in the Combat Round. The Alien Stiletto may be voluntarily discarded in the controlling player's Briefing Phase. Add 10 to your [RP] Pool and remove the Alien Stiletto from the game.

name: Alien Technology
Text: Play after one of your Teams successfully investigates a Site with ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY skill as a prerequisite. Place this card in your Bureau. Discard this card to negate one ALIEN or GOVERNMENT Adversary.

name: Alien Technology
Text: Play after one of your Teams successfully investigates a Site with Alien Investigation or Bureaucracy skill as a prerequisite. Place this card in your Bureau. Discard this card to negate one Alien or Government Adversary.
Dialogue: "There were tanks here, and five bodies suspended in solution. There were computers monitoring them. They were alive Scully, underwater!" - Mulder

name: Alien Uses Oil as Transportation Medium
Text: Play this card to give any one Agent ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill equal to their CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill level for the rest of this turn.
Dialogue: "I don't think this is just ordinary diesel oil, Scully. I think it's a…I think it's a medium…a medium being used by some kind of alien creature that uses it to… body jump." -  Mulder

name: Aliens Monitor the Project
Text: Play this card after playing a Keyword ALIEN Adversary and resolving the Combat. You may play one additional Adversary from your hand with the Keyword ALIEN or GOVERNMENT for zero [CP] ignoring Activator requirements.
Dialogue: Scully: "What happened to you?"Mulder: "They got a small army outside. I think they got us trapped."Scully: " I think there's a way out, down here."

name: All Lies Lead to the Truth
Text: Place this card in one of your opponents Fields. Your opponent must subtract 1 from the [CP] he generates each turn while this card is in his Field. Your opponent may pay 5 [CP] to force you to discard this card.
Dialogue: "When I went to work for the FBI, I didn't know of my father's crimes. When I stood up to him, he shot me." - Jeffrey Spender

name: Alonso Bilac
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.
Dialogue: Alonso Bilac: "I spent the last six months living with the Secona, learning from them, coming to understand the nature and the depth of their culture."Scully: "Well, apparently, they've learned something from you too."Bilac: "Yes. I've been teaching them the joys of American bureaucracy."

name: Alpha-Scramble
Text: Force the investigating Team back to the Bureau immediately. The Team may not contribute to any skill checks this turn. If one of the Agents has an "Uniden Bearcat UBC-125XLT", this card has no effect.

name: Alvin Kurtzweil
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword BUREAUCRACY or GOVERNMENT card is played.
Dialogue: "There's something you don't know about the bombing in Dallas." - A. Kurtzweil

name: Amaru Urn
Text: Place in an opponent's Field. An OCCULT Adversary may now be played as a Bluff (it is treated as a Bluff for all purposes). When revealed the Adversary may ignore Site Activator restrictions. Discard when a Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION Site is directed at you and investigated successfully.

name: Ambassador Hotel, Washington, D.C.
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: Mulder: "I work with Assistant Director Skinner. I'd like to speak with him."Waltos: "You can see him after he gives his statement. We're gonna finish up at the station house."

name: Ambulance
Text: Discard this card to add three to the Agent's MEDICAL skill.

name: Ambush
Text: Play this card on any combatant with a SUBTERFUGE skill of 1+ or that is capable of using SUBTERFUGE cards. The opposing side's LONG RANGE COMBAT attack is negated this round.

name: Ambush

name: Ammunition Reload
Text: Play this card on any Agent during a LONG RANGE COMBAT round to double that Agent's LRC skill. This effect must be applied before any other modifier and only over the LRC listed on that Agent's card.
Dialogue: "Protect me and mine with your quickening power." - Jared Chirp

name: Angie Pintero
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or OBSERVATION skill check.
Dialogue: Angie Pintero: "You think Harold killed those women?"Mulder: "You obviously don't think so, huh?"Pintero: "Harold's worked for me for 10 years. He might be crazy but he couldn't kill anyone. He's a sweet kid."

name: Angie's Midnight Bowl, Washington, D.C.
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
Dialogue: Scully: "This is where you saw the body?"Angie Pintero: "Yes ma'am. She was caught up in the machinery. Her neck was cut."

name: Angry Townspeople
Text: Play this card to increase the cost of all [RP] cards played at this Site by 1.

name: Animated Snakes
Text: Play this card for 2 [CP] less if played on a Site card with the Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION.
Dialogue: Scully: "..Maybe it's symbolic. I mean, serpents and religion have gone hand in hand. They've represented the temptation of Eve -- Original Sin. They've been feared and hated throughout history as they've been thought to embody Satan -- to serve Evil itself".

name: Ansel Bray
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.
Dialogue: Mulder: "You think Big Blue is responsible for what's been happening?"Ansel Bray: "Don't you?"Mulder: "Have you ever actually seen it?"Bray: "Not directly, no. But I aim to. One day I'll be in the right place at the right time, and I will snap a shot of that monster."

name: Answers to Everything
Episode: The Lost Art of Forehead Sweat
Text: Play this card immediately after incorrectly guessing the identity of your opponent's X-File. You may ask one additional question about the same Characteristic (e.g., RESULT)'. Each player may have only one of this card in their deck. Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: "They gave us all the answers to everything! Even Sasquatch. No! It's not true!" - Mulder

name: Apollo 11 Keychain
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's RES value. This card may be attached at zero cost if played after one of your Agents has been removed from the game. Each player may only have one of this card in their decks.
Dialogue: "I just thought it was a pretty cool keychain." - Mulder

name: Apology is Policy
Text: Play this card to change a negative skill check modifier to a positive one (e.g., a -1 becomes a +1).
Dialogue: Scully: "Apology has become policy."Mulder: "I don't need an apology for the lies."

name: Application For FBI Resources Approved
Text: If the Team makes a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check, you may borrow any one of your opponent's Agents. It may not be an Agent you already control. Add the Agent to the Team for the remainder of the turn. Afterward, the Agent returns to the original owner's control. The Agent must be returned to the Team it belonged to or sent to the Hospital if the Agent was reduced to 0 HEALTH during a combat.

name: Ariel's Wedding Ring

Dialogue: "It's a communal wedding ring made in Colon, a village near Prague. My father was an apprentice to the man who designed it." - Ariel Weiss

name: Arlington National Cemetery, Arlington County, Virginia

name: Arthur Dales

Dialogue: "You don't have much time to get to the airport but if you're the X-Files man you say you are you better get your butt in gear." - Arthur Dales

name: Artificially Intelligent Dung-Eating Robotic Probes
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. The Probes make one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT attack and are then discarded.
Bio: "Well, think of it this way Mulder…by the time there's another invasion of artificially intelligent, dung-eating robotic probes from outer space, maybe their uber-children will have devised a way to save our planet. -  Scully

name: ASAC Dakota Whitney
Game Effect: ASAC Dakota Whitney's OBSERVATION and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills are increased by one if she and Agent Mosley Drummy are on the same Team.
Bio: Dakota Whitney is an ASAC and a Special Agent in Charge at the FBI. While investigating the deaths of multiple abductees, she was instrumental in arranging the involvement of Agents Mulder and Scully.

name: Ashen Whispers

Despite his political maneuvers and skepticism towards the X-Files, he aided Doggett in a crucial investigation. However, his involvement in organized crime tainted his reputation, leaving his future uncertain, possibly facing criminal charges.

Bio: As a toddler, Delaney Arvidson was imbued with psychokinetic abilities, the result of prolonged exposure to mystical runes hidden within her favorite stuffed animal. Agents Mulder and Scully learned of her powers while investigating a string of grisly murders near Delaney's home.

Text: The Demonic Puppet initiates Combat but does not assign nor receive any damage. Instead, the selected Agent in a Team inflicts a wound upon himself or herself equal to the sum of their LRC & CRC values, applied only once. Healing cards may be used to prevent damage, including any Combat cards that do not modify LRC and/or CRC.
Dialogue: Scully: "Give me the doll, Polly."

name: Denny Markham
Text: Attach this Witness to any one Keyword INDEPENDENT Agent. Adds 1 to the Agent's SUBTERFUGE skill once per turn. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.
Dialogue: "The Right Hand believes in empowering the individual over a corrupt and corrupting federal government. We're prepared for the time when armed resistance will be necessary." - Denny Markham

name: Denny Murphy, Geologist
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's SCIENCES or adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check. If your opponent plays an ALIEN Adversary while this card is in play, Murphy is negated and removed from the game.
Dialogue: Denny Murphy: "...Professor of geology at U. C. San Diego."Mulder: "San Diego? You get much of a chance to study ice down there?"

name: Dental X-Ray Plate
Text: Discard this card to add three to the Agent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill.

name: Deny Everything
Text: Play this card immediately after your opponent asks you a question. You may respond with this phrase: "I can neither confirm nor deny that assumption." After playing this card remove it from the game.

name: Deny Everything
Text: Play this card immediately after your opponent asks you a question. You may respond with this phrase: "I can neither confirm nor deny that assumption." After playing this card remove it from the game.
Dialogue: "We have a vaccine. Developed by the Russians, stolen by Krycek, given to me." - The Well-Manicured Man

name: Deputy Alvin Kersh
Game Effect: Treat Dep. Director Alvin Kersh as a RES 3 if he is in the Bureau Section of the table. Kersh also allows you to choose to add to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resource Pool during the Briefing Phase.
Bio: Alvin Kersh obstructed Mulder and Scully's paranormal investigations, assigning them mundane tasks, later Overseeing their work. Kersh, a former U.S. Air Force pilot, brought military discipline to his role. His skepticism towards the X-Files drove bureaucratic actions, often impeding the Agents their pursuit of the Truth.

name: Deputy Barney Paster
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Remove a token during the Requisition Phase to search your Bureau Deck for any one Keyword WEAPON or ARMOR Equipment card and attach it to Paster at half cost (rounded up). Reshuffle your Deck.
Bio: Barney Paster was the sole Deputy residing in the rural town of Home, Pennsylvania. Following the brutal murder of Sheriff Andy Taylor and Mrs. Taylor, Paster led Agents Mulder and Scully in an aggressive charge on the Peacock Family's farmhouse.

name: Deputy Chief Tommy 'Hawk' Hill
Text: Attach this Witness to a Team. This Witness will add his skills to the appropriate skill check like an Agent, CRC: 3, LRC: 3, and HEALTH: 3. If he is sent to the Hospital, or at any time there are no Agents in the Team, remove the card from the game.
Dialogue: "Harry, Hawk here. The trout’s heading upstream towards the net." - Hawk

name: Deputy Dennis Tyson
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check, or play this card to negate "Sheriff Daniels".
Dialogue: "Sir? Gonna have to ask you to come with me. District Attorney wants to ask you some questions concerning the boy's death." - Deputy Tyson

name: Deputy Director Gordon Cole
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This may be used to pay for any Keyword BUREAUCRACY, LIMINAL or OCCULT INVESTIGATION cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.
Bio: Gordon Cole is a veteran FBI agent and head of the Blue Rose Task Force. Known for his sharp instincts and partial deafness, he leads investigations into paranormal phenomena, including the mystery of Dale Cooper's disappearance and return. Loyal and fearless.

name: Desk Jockey
Text: Play on an opposing Agent in the Bureau. The Agent may not leave the Bureau or add their skills to a skill check until a Team has successfully investigated a Site with Keywords CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION.
Dialogue: "Why don't I have a desk?" - Scully

name: Desktop Computer
Text: Discard this card to add three to the Agent's COMPUTER skill.

name: Detective Aaron Dross
Game Effect: Place three tokens on Detective Aaron Dross. Once per turn, as the Active Player, you may remove a token to discard a card and draw two from your Bureau deck.
Bio: Detective Aaron Dross is a local law enforcement officer who reaches out to FBI for help with an unsettling case. Tasked with investigating eerie, unexplained events, he relies on Mulder and Scully's expertise in the paranormal to uncover the truth.

name: Detective Alan Cross
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION or adds 1 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE skill check.

name: Detective Angela White
Game Effect: If Detective White is in the same Team as Agent Mulder, they both gain a +1 to their cumulative OCCULT INVESTIGATION and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills, and a -1 to their OBSERVATION and BEHAVIORAL skills.

name: Detective Barron
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Detective Barron. Discard a token to play a Bluff card from your hand at half its cost. Additionally, Barron's BEHAVIORAL and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills are increased by one if he and Agent Kelly Ryan are in the same Team.
Bio: Barron was a detective with the Richmond, Virginia police and the superior of Kelly Ryan. He was an extremely short-tempered man who viewed the involvement of the FBI as an intrusion onto his turf.

name: Detective Cline
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION or OBSERVATION skill check. While this card is in play, the Witness card "The Stupendous Yappi" may be played for free.

name: Detective Dave Macklay
Game Effect: Detective Dave Macklay gains +1 OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill if he is in a Team with an Agent who has the BELIEVER Keyword or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill.
Bio: Detective Dave Macklay investigated Ruth Davenport's murder, linking fingerprints to Bill Hastings. He coordinated with the FBI uncovering connections to alternate dimensions and Major Garland Briggs. Macklay witnessed bizarre phenomena, including Hastings' death, and confirmed the presence of mysterious, shadowy figures nearby.

name: Detective Frank Briggs
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Detective Frank Briggs
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Detective Glen Chao
Game Effect: An opposing Conspiracy player may pay two conspiracy points to send Detective Chao back to your Bureau if Detective Chao is investigating a Site with CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION, EVIDENCE COLLECTION, or BUREAUCRACY.
Bio: Detective Chao worked as an enforcer for one of China Town's Tong gangs. When Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully were called in to investigate a series of strange deaths, Chao had a change of heart and helped them to stop the Tong from killing them.

name: Detective Havez
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check. May be played for Cost minus 1 RP if Witness "Detective Cline" is in play.

name: Detective Hudak
Game Effect: During your Investigation Phase, add 1 [RP] to your pool if a Team including Detective Hudak is assigned to a Keyword MONO Site. The cost of any Witness card played at this Site is increased by 1 [RP].
Bio: Hudak is a hard - boiled Washington D.C. detective who investigated the murder of Penny Timmons. Unlike Agent Mulder, Hudak firmly believed that Harold Spuller was the prime suspect.

name: Detective Joe Curtis
Text: Force your opponent to discard one Witness from their hand. If your opponent has no Witnesses in their hand, this card has no effect. If your opponent has a Witness to discard, attach Detective Curtis to one Investigating Agent (your choice). The Agent is arrested and removed from play until the remaining Agents make a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check.
Dialogue: Scully: "You're jailing an innocent man."Detective Curtis: "Yeah, well, this way he won't get lost for two days and do something else he won't remember."

name: Detective John Kresge
Game Effect: If Detective Kresge is in the same Team as Agent Scully, they both gain a +1 to their cumulative OBSERVATION and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills, and a -1 to their SUBTERFUGE and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills.
Bio: Detective John Kresge was a seasoned San Diego police officer that assisted Agent Dana Scully in investigating Mrs. Roberta Sim's apparent suicide. He updated her on Marshall Sim's confession regarding the murder case. This interaction showcases Kresge's role as a reliable ally to Scully.

name: Detective John Munch
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Remove a token when your opponent asks you a penalty question. You may respond with the following phrase: "Aluminum makes a lovely hat."
Bio: John Munch was a cynical detective for Baltimore Homicide unit in 1989 when he interrogated John Fitzgerald Byers about a mysterious shooting in a Fells Point warehouse and a delirious FBI Agent. Despite his belief in conspiracy theories, Munch was skeptical of Byers' story.

name: Detective Kelly Ryan

name: Detective Kelly Ryan

name: Detective Kelly Ryan
Game Effect: Place one token on Detective Kelly Ryan. Discard a token to look through your Bureau deck any time during the game to draw any one Bluff card. Show the Bluff to your opponent and shuffle the deck.
Bio: Kelly Ryan became a detective with the Richmond Police Department in Virginia after being tutored as a student of Dana Scully. She asked for assistance from Scully and Mulder when investigating a bizarre series of murders and while searching for Dr. Chester Ray Banton.

name: Detective Manners
Game Effect: Place two tokens on Detective Manners. Discard one token to search through your Bureau deck and add a Witness card to your hand. Show the Witness to your opponent and shuffle the deck.

name: Detective Miles

name: Detective Miles

name: Detective Neary
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "We've got a big influx of immigrants from Hong Kong, trying to get out before 1997. And we've seen stepped-up gang activity in the Chinese community. But so far we can't tie these deaths to anyone or anything." -  Detective Neary

name: Detective Norman
Game Effect: Detective Norman's LONG RANGE COMBAT skill is doubled against any EVOLUTIONARY adversary played on any Team he belongs. Additionally, if Detective Norman is in any Team including Fox Mulder, add 1 to Norman's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill.
Bio: Norman was a detective with the Newark County Police Department who was Mulder's contact in New Jersey on what Mulder initially thought was a routine homicide investigation.

name: Detective Pennock
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Remove a token to look through your Bureau deck to draw any keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck.
Bio: Lloyd Pennock was part of the local police force in Wilmington, Delaware. He investigated a murder at Paradise Motel and encountered Marty Glenn, a blind woman, near the victim. Collaborating with Mulder and Scully, Pennock navigated the enigma, maintaining an open mind in uncovering Marty's mysterious Capabilities.

name: Detective Sharon Lazard
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.

Dialogue: "I don't work for you sir, and unless you hear differently from the Attorney General, this case is a local matter." - Detective Thompson

name: Detective Waltos
Game Effect: Place one token on Detective Waltos. Discard one token to search through your Bureau deck and add an Equipment card of cost not higher than 2 [RP]. Add it to your hand, reshuffle your Bureau deck. If the card drawn is the "Lie Detector" you may attach it to Waltos immediately for zero cost.
Bio: Detective Waltos was in charge of the investigation into the murder of Carina Sayles, of which Assistant Director Walter Skinner was accused. Skinner, a suspect in the murder case, was uncooperative, refusing to take a lie-detector test.

name: Detectove Costa
Game Effect: Place three tokens on Detective Costa. You may remove one token per turn to add +1 to his OBSERVATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills during a skill check he participates in.
Bio: Detective Costa is a police detective who assists Mulder and Scully during the investigation of the Ghouli case. He provides crucial information, including details about the mysterious 911 call and the victim's connection to a figure named Ghouli.

name: Die Hand Die Verletzt
Text: Spielen Sie diese Karte zum Durchsuchen Ihres Büro Stapels. Dann wählen Sie einen OCCULT Gegner, mit dem Sie automatisch den AgentenTeam zur Ortserkundung angehören. Der OCCULT Gegner kann anstatt der 0 [CP] gespielt werden, unter Mißachtung der Aktivierungs-Anforderungen.English Translation: You may search your Bureau deck and take any Occult Creature and you may play it on the agents team making the skill check. You may play it at any site. (Meaning you can play an Adversary with Activator Affiliation on a Motive, Method, or Result site as well.) This costs 0 [CP].

name: Die Wahrheit ist irgendwo da draußen
Text: Play this card to force an opponent Team currently investigating a Site to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they fail only Agents with the Keyword FBI may contribute their skills to any skill check made on this Site.
Dialogue: Mulder: "This ship's been caught in something called the devil's triangle. It's some kind of time warp. A rift in space."

name: Diner Confidential
Text: Play this card during a skill check. You may discard two cards from your hand to gain +1 to that skill check, or discard four cards to gain +2 instead. You cannot discard more than four cards this way.
Dialogue: "Shelly, you've got your own life to worry about right now. I'll be fine here." - Norma

name: Diner Cook
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: Jose Chung: "That is odd. Because almost every day I was there, I ate lunch at that diner and became dear friends with the cook. He told me a story about the night you're talking about. A man walked into his place, sat down, ordered sweet potato pie, identified himself as F.B.I. Agent Mulder. He then questioned my friend."Mulder: "Ever seen a UFO in these parts?"Chung: "He then ordered piece after piece, each time asking another question…"

name: Dio Ti Ama
Text: Place this card in your field. The cost of all [RP] cards you play this turn is halved (rounded up). Discard this card at the end of this turn. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.
Dialogue: Scully: "She found me."Mulder: "So you could save her."

name: Disarm
Text: Adversaries that can use MARTIAL ARTS may play this card in a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round to cause one Equipment card from the opposing side to be discarded. If the Equipment normally adds to CRC skill check, then it is discarded before it may do so.

name: Disbelief
Text: Play this card on any Agent with the keyword SKEPTIC to prevent that Agent from contributing their skills at any keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION or ALIEN INVESTIGATION Site.

name: Disciplinary Actions
Text: Play on an opposing Agent. Place three tokens on this card and move the Agent to the Bureau. Remove a token during the opponent's Debriefing Phase. The Agent may not leave the Bureau until all tokens have been removed. While in the Bureau the Agent may not receive or use any equipment; nor may the Agent contribute to any Skill checks.
Dialogue: "It is the recommendation of the Office of Professional Conduct that Special Agent Dana Scully be given a mandatory leave of absence until the full detail of her misconduct can be calculated." -  Senior Agent

name: Discovering the Truth
Text: Play this card to reveal any face down card by turning it face up (except your opponent's X-File). If it has the Keyword "Secret", it is discarded.
Dialogue: Victor Klemper: "Progress demands sacrifice, and I… I have confronted my demons. And soon I will die too."Mulder: " Like my father. They killed him and I believe you know why."

name: Disinformation Campaign
Text: Play this card to change the Site Prerequisite from ALIEN INVESTIGATION to CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION.
Dialogue: Man in Black: "Even the former leader of your United States of America, James Earl Carter Jr, thought he saw a UFO once. But it's been proven he only saw the planet Venus."Roky Crikenson: "I'm a republican!"Man in Black: "Venus was at its peak brilliance last night. You probably thought you saw something up in the sky other than Venus, but I assure you… it was Venus."

name: Dissection

name: Distracting Vision

Dialogue: "According to Skinner's psychiatrist, he's been experiencing a recurring dream in which he's confronted by an old woman." - Scully

name: DNA Vision Goggles
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's MEDICAL and SCIENCES skills. You cannot sell this card during the Briefing phase to gain [CP] points.
Dialogue: "I don't believe this. There's nothing. There's no alien DNA. I saw it when I sequenced my genome. It was near the centromere on cromosome 17."- Scully

name: Doctor Lorenz

Dialogue: "High serotonin levels have been associated with mania." - Doctor Lorenz

Bio: Detective Don Harrison of the South Dakota State Police investigated the mysterious murder of Ruth Davenport. He questioned William Hastings and, alongside Detective Dave Macklay, uncovered a piece of flesh in Hastings' car and a ring hidden inside a decapitated corpse.

name: Don't Turn Around!
Text: Play this card to apply a -2 modifier to the Site skill check. In addition, one Agent on the Team (your choice) may not contribute their Combat skills this turn.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Scully? Are you seeing this?"Scully: "Listen to me very carefully, Guillaume. We're gonna get you outta there."

name: Donnie's Deadly Game
Text: This card can only be played during the Case Assignment Phase to return a Site card played by your opponent back to their hand.
Dialogue: Satin: "You want me to shampoo my hair?"Donnie: "I'm happy to pay extra, if that's something out of the ordinary."

name: Doppelganger Agent

Remove target Agent from play (Equipment and tokens included) and replace it with this card, representing a doppelganger with all skills reduced by one. Owner may use the Agent normally. At the end of the turn, discard this card and return the original Agent.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "Who called the cops?" - Eddie Van Blundht

name: Double Agent

Dialogue: "Keeping Fox Mulder down is not a job. It's your dirty work!" - Spender

name: Double Trouble: Plus One
Text: This Adversary is an exact copy of any Agent card in the Team investigating this Site (your choice) and will engage in Combat only with that Agent. Follow normal Combat rules until one of the Agents (or both) reaches a HEALTH value of zero.
Dialogue: "My rational mind knows that you are only... a manifest psychic ideation borne of latent hostility." - Scully

I held him for the first day, but I detected none in the symptoms of the others. His leukocytes and erythrocytes were high - actually, he was in very good health." -  Dr. Seizer

Use that number as a negative skill modifier on target Agent's skill (your choice) until end of turn. The chosen skill cannot decrease below zero. Shuffle the Drawn cards into the Bureau deck afterwards.
Dialogue: Lyda "You look like you saw a ghost. There are ghosts in this house, you know…"

name: Hazardous Sample

name: He Won't Let Me Die
Text: Play this card when an Agent in the Field has been reduced to zero Health and is to be moved to the Hospital or removed from the game. Increase the Agent's Health to 3 (no matter how much damage has been dealt) and leave the Agent in the Field.
Dialogue: Lt. Colonel Victor Stans: "Your time has come, he said. Then he started taking it all away."Scully: "What did he start taking away?"Stans: "Everything. My wife… my children…"Scully: "And how did he do that?"Stans: "How did… He burned them alive… Now he makes me suffer. Because he won't let me die."

name: He's Gonna Find You
Text: Play this card to allow Adversaries to attack one Team of Agents anywhere in the Field, Bureau, or Hospital, ignoring Activator requirements.
Dialogue: "Kevin? I know you're here, son." -  Simon Gates

name: Head Calusari
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword PRIMORDIAL or OCCULT INVESTIGATION card is played.
Dialogue: "The evil that is here has always been. It has gone by different names through history - Cain, Lucifer, Hitler. It does not care if it kills one boy or a million men. If you try to stop us, the blood will be on your hands." - Head Calusari

name: Head X-Ray Plate
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's MEDICAL skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill.
Dialogue: "It looks like a computer chip." - Scully

name: Heads Up

name: Healing Regurgitation
Text: Play this card to recover an Agent that was killed and removed from play, where X is the cost of that Agent. Remove this card from the game. Each player may have only one of this card in their deck.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "The doctor says Mrs. Hangemuhl's kidneys have spontaneously healed. She's a healthy woman." - Doggett

name: Helicopter Spotter

name: Henry Weems

Dialogue: "What if he got really, really lucky? That's your big scientific explanation, Scully?" - Mulder

name: Heroic Leap

Dialogue: "Mulder, don't get on the train…" -  Scully

Dialogue: "It's open. Can I help you?" - Geraldine

name: Hide

Dialogue: "I thought we might at least allow ourselves to reminisce." - Cigarette Smoking Man

name: High Frequency Wave
Text: The High Frequency Wave is unaffected by Combat attacks. It will attack once in one LONG RANGE COMBAT round and one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round, then it is discarded.
Dialogue: "It was a high-pitched frequency like - like a steel spike being driven through my head." - Mulder

Text: One Agent equipped with a "Government Car" may use this card to make one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT attack at CRC skill: 6. Any damage allocated to the Agent is taken by the car first. The car is destroyed after taking six hits. Hits in excess of those needed to destroy the car are applied to the Agent. Discard the "Government Car" card after this combat round is resolved.

The car is destroyed after taking six hits. Hits in excess of those needed to destroy the car are applied to the Agent. Discard the "Government Car" card after this combat round is resolved.

name: Hog Hideout Hazard
Text: Force an opposing Team to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they fail, choose one Agent to go to the Hospital (undamaged).
Dialogue: "Is there some secret farmer trick to get these things moving?" - Mulder

name: Hollins, Roanoke County, VA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question. If you ask if the MOTIVE is "Control", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.
Dialogue: Scully: "This isn't an X-File?"Mulder: "Call it what you like. Here in Roanoke they're calling it a demon baby snatching."

name: Holtzman, D.S.A.

(1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: Home Call
Text: Search through your Bureau deck for any one Site card with Keyword RESULT. Show the card to your opponent and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck.
Dialogue: "I'm Assistant Director Walter Skinner with the FBI. May we come in?." - Skinner

name: Hong Kong
Question: You may ask one METHOD question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: Jeraldine Kallenchuk: "I'm a middle man Mr Mulder, pardon my gender type. I take a cut, then slice off the top. It would be bad business to divulge my sources."Mulder: "Why did you run off to Hong Kong?"Kallenchuk: "To meet the buyer."Mulder: "To sell him what?"Kallenchuk: "Pardon your gender type."

name: Hope vs Selfishness
Text: Pay X [CP] to remove X [RP] from your opponent's pool immediately, or vice versa.
Dialogue: "Find Agent Scully. Only then will you realize the scope and grandeur of the project. Go. Go now!" - Well-manicured Man

name: Hospital Crash Cart
Text: This piece of Equipment does not need to be attached to any Agent. Place three tokens on the Hospital Crash Cart. Discard one token to heal one point of damage to an Agent in the Hospital. Discard when all three tokens have been expended.

name: Hospital Crash Cart

name: Hospital Gown
Text: Attach this card to an Agent in the Hospital and place two tokens on it. Discard a token to either heal one point of damage or to remove a game effect token from the Agent. Discard the Hospital Gown when all tokens have been removed.
Dialogue: "Mom, I'm fine. I'm going to be fine, I'm just here for treatment." - Scully

name: Hostage Negotiations
Text: Play this card on a Team of Agents. Each Combat card discarded from your hand gives the Team a +1 modifier to the Site skill check. X = the number of Combat cards discarded.
Dialogue: Lucy Kazdin: "His name's Duane Barry. He's armed with a nine millimeter Smith and Wesson handgun, one nine-round magazine. It is our belief he is prepared to use the gun and not afraid to die."Mulder: "What does he want?"Kazdin: "Safe passage for himself and his original hostage, a shrink named Hakkie."

name: Hostages
Text: Play after an Adversary card has been successfully played on a Site. Discard a card from your hand to add X [CP] to your pool. X = Half the cost of the Adversary played (rounded down).
Dialogue: "I just want to say that I believe you." - Kimberley

name: Hotel James Monroe, Boston, MA
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.
Dialogue: Mulder: "I just spoke with the bellman who brought up the luggage."Scully: "What did he say?"Mulder: "The iceman cometh."

name: Human Shield
Text: Play during CLOSE RANGE COMBAT on any Adversary with the Keyword GOVERNMENT or that is capable of using SUBTERFUGE cards. The Adversary may capture any one Agent from the opposing Team. Any damage done to the Adversary during this CRC round is applied to the captured Agent instead. Any excess damage is applied to the Adversary as normal.

name: Hutch & Chantal

Dialogue: "That douchebag is really pissing me off!" - Chantal

name: I Want To Believe

Dialogue: Scully: "Oh! This came for you."Mulder: "Thank you."

name: I'm Not Your Source
Text: Play this card in an opponent's Field and place two tokens on it. Discard a token to prevent your opponent from playing any Events or Witnesses while investigating a Site. Does not affect Events or Witnesses currently in play. Discard this card when no tokens remain.
Dialogue: Mulder: "I get an anonymous e-mail to come meet you here in the middle of the night, I don't know who you are or what you want."The Plain-Clothes Man: "I don't have any obligation or desire to give you any answers. I'm not one of your sources."

name: I've Got the Tape
Text: You may place up to 3 [RP] from your Resource Pool on this card when it comes into play. Discard 1 [RP] token to double the [CP] Cost of any one ALIEN Adversary played by your opponent. If your opponent cannot or chooses not to pay the additional Cost, the Adversary card is discarded. When no tokens remain on this card, move it to your Discard Pile.
Dialogue: "I'm sure of this… if I so much as feel your presence, I'm going to make you a very, very famous man." -  Krycek

name: Icy Cape, AK

name: Icy Cape, AK

name: Identity Intrusion

Dialogue: Scully: "What does that mean?"Mulder: "It means... It means whatever you want it to mean. Good night."

name: Identity Swap
Text: Play this card at the beginning of the Briefing Phase. You may exchange one of your Agents with any Agent controlled by your opponent, with the same or lower [RP] cost and in the same section of the table (including tokens and attached cards). Both players may use their new Agents as usual, except for their Game Effect. At the end of this turn exchange the Agents again in their final locations (sections).
Dialogue: Mulder: "Scully! He's not me!"

name: Ike "The Spike" Stadtler
Dialogue: "Squeeze his hand off!" - The Arm

name: Immunity for Loyalty
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in the Team investigating this Site. Each time this Agent contributes to a skill check, you must place a damage token on them. Remove this card when the Agent is sent to the Hospital with zero HEALTH. Only one of this card may be in play at a time.
Dialogue: "This faith in technology our new religion... When a simple pathogen would kill billions and billions." - Carl Gerhard Busch

name: Implant Records and Steals Memory
Text: Play after your opponent has completed a successful Site skill check. Remove up to 4 [RP] from your opponent's Resource Pool.
Dialogue: Agent Pendrell: "This kind of neural network could be not only collecting information, but artificially replicating a person's mental processes."Scully: "You could know a person's every thought."Pendrell: "Frightening…"

name: Improved Channels
Text: The Team must make a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check. If successful, you may now have up to ten cards in hand at the end of your turn. This condition stays in effect until you are forced to discard this card. Discard this card if one of your Agents is moved from or to the Bureau Section of the table for any reason.

name: Improved Channels
