name: In Deep Shadows
Text: Play this card to negate search through your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: The End, Second's Elder Deliberation, Covering Up Evidence, or the Toothpick Man. If you play the chosen card immediately, you may do so at half cost (rounded up). Alternatively, you can use this card to negate the effect of William.
Dialogue: "Your son has to die." - Robert Comer

name: In the Ashes, Silence
Text: Place this card next to your X-File. Remove this card from play at any time to discard all Keyword RESOURCE cards in play.
Dialogue: "This is the water, and this is the well. Drink full and descend. The horse is the white of the eyes and dark within." - The Woodsman

name: In the Big Inning
Text: Play this card immediately after a Team of Agents has successfully investigated a Site and asked a Characteristic question regarding your X-File. If the question is answered with "yes", add 3 tokens to your [RP] pool.
Dialogue: "…what you may find is you concentrate on hitting that little ball… The rest of the world just fades away-- all your everyday, nagging concerns." - Mulder

name: In the Crosshairs
Text: Flip a coin in the air. If the coin lands on heads, your opponent must discard the following cards from their hand: "No One So Paranoid", "The Lone Gunmen", "Langly", "Frohike", "Byers", and "Call On Us More Often". The listed cards may not be used to negate this card.
Dialogue: "I can kill you whenever I please…but not today." - The Cigarette - Smoking Man

name: In-Service Training
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal, and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: COMPUTER, MEDICAL, or SCIENCES. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: In-Service Training
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal, and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: COMPUTER, MEDICAL, or SCIENCES. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: Incanto Stalks Prey Over Internet
Text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite from COMPUTER to BEHAVIORAL.
Dialogue: "Our killer may have moved from the personal columns and onto the internet. I'm sending out a localized online warning…" -  Mulder

name: Inexplicable Mind Vibes
Text: Move one Agent with the Keyword BELIEVER (your choice) to the Hospital immediately (undamaged). The Agent may not contribute to any skill checks this turn.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "They are coming." - Mulder

name: Infected That You Might Believe
Text: Play this card and place it beneath one Agent to lower all of that Agent's skill levels by 1. This cannot result in a skill being negative or permanent Health being less than 1. When played on Agent Dana Scully, the conspiracy player may choose to force Scully to spend every other turn in the Hospital (if this option is chosen, Scully's skills are not reduced). This choice must be made when the card is played and cannot be changed later. Healing cards will negate this card.

name: Informant on the Intelligence Committee
Text: Play this card to give any one Agent SUBTERFUGE skill equal to their CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill level for the rest of this turn.
Dialogue: "I understand you're in a difficult position. Don't look so stunned. I'm on the Intelligence Committee. Secrets are the only real currency we deal in." -  Senator Matheson

name: Injured Relative
Text: Force one opposing Agent (your choice) to go to the Hospital immediately (undamaged).

name: Inova Fairfax Medical Campus, Falls Church, VA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "She's not gone. Not her soul." - A. Pauley

name: Insanity on Rye
Text: Place this card on an opposing Agent in the Field to change one Keyword LAW or INDEPENDENT to INSANITY. This card is removed when a Healing card is played on the afflicted Agent.
Dialogue: "Ergot is a parasite that lives off of rye and related grasses. Svo said that he used rye somehow in his ink. Now if this is true, we may be subject to hallucinogenic ergotism. Aural, visual hallucinations. Dangerous and unlikely behavior." - Scully

name: Inspector Phoebe Green
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token to move Agent Fox Mulder from anywhere on the table to the Team Phoebe Green is in. Mulder may assist in any skill check made by the team. In this manner, Mulder may assist on two Sites in one turn.

name: Inspector Phoebe Green
Game Effect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token to move Agent Fox Mulder from anywhere on the table to the Team Phoebe Green is in. Mulder may assist in any skill check made by the team. In this manner, Mulder may assist on two Sites in one turn.

name: Inspector Puett
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check, or play this card to force your opponent to randomly shuffle one card from their hand back into their Bureau Deck.
Dialogue: "United States Postal Inspector. My office is investigating a mail theft - one which we've traced to your missing person, Ms. Mary Louise LeFante." - Inspector Puett

name: Internal Bleeding
Text: Play on any Agent that has taken two or more points of damage from a single damage source. That Agent must go to the Hospital immediately and may no longer participate in the combat. The Agent may not leave the Hospital until he is fully healed.

name: Internal Bleeding
Text: Play on any Agent that has taken two or more points of damage from a single damage source. That Agent must go to the Hospital immediately and may no longer participate in the combat. The Agent may not leave the Hospital until he is fully healed.

name: Interrogations
Text: Place two tokens on this card. Discard one token to double one Witness modifier for the remainder of your turn. This may only be done once per turn. When no tokens remain, move this card to the discard pile.
Dialogue: Harold Lamb: "If she says I raped her, then I guess I raped her."Mulder: "You don't sound so sure of that."Lamb: "It all seems so crazy and I don't know why Chrissy remembers it that way."Mulder: "Would you be willing to take a lie detector test to prove that you raped her?"Lamb: "No, I'm not."

name: Intruder Counter-Measures Program
Text: Play to add 2 [CP] to your pool immediately.

name: Intruder Counter-Measures Program
Text: Play to add 2 [CP] to your pool immediately.

name: Invitation to the Other Side
Text: Play this card to remove one Agent from play until the end of the turn. This card may be played at any time, except during Combat, but it can be used in response to an opponent playing an Adversary card. X is the [CP] cost of that Agent.
Dialogue: "This would look nice on your wall." - Mrs. Tremond

name: Ish-Tribal Elder
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Ish-Tribal Elder
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Ivory Coast, West Africa
Question: You may ask one METHOD question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "I, too, am a professor of biology at the university but, uh, hardly one qualified to say what must have gone on here." - Amina Ngebe

name: Jack Rabbit's Palace, Twin Peaks, WA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Two hundred and fifty-three yards due east. And we have to put some soil in our pockets." - Hawk

name: Jacques Renault
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION or adds 2 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE skill check. If played on 'One eyed Jacks, Canada' Site, this card costs 1 [RP] less.
Dialogue: "Laura, she is all tied up. Oh, she liked that. The bird, he starts pecking on her shoulder." - Jacques Renault

name: Jailbreak
Text: Play on an Agent in the section of the table designated The Gulag. The imprisoned Agent is immediately moved to the Bureau (undamaged).
Dialogue: "Back on your horses! We must find him!" - Gulag Commandant, in Russian

name: Jake & Gene, The Snippers Alliance
Text: The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. Jake & Gene may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards. Your opponent may pay 4 [RP] to force you to discard this card.
Dialogue: "Oh my God! Gene, he's not in the car!" - Jake

name: James Hurley
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check.
Dialogue: "I think something scared her, because she wouldn't see me. She wouldn't even talked to me." - James Hurley

name: Janke Dacyshyn
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. Dacyshyn engages one opposing Agent (your choice) in Combat. If Dacyshyn reduces the Agent to zero HEALTH, place this card on top of the Agent along with 3 tokens. Remove one token during each Briefing Phase. When no tokens are on the Agent, move the Agent to the Hospital including the damage tokens. This card is considered an ABDUCTION card.
Dialogue: "I'm transporting vital organ." - Janke Dacyshyn

name: Jason Ludwig
Text: Play to change a Site Prerequisite to BEHAVIORAL 3+.
Dialogue: Jason Ludwig: "Trepkos is what happened here."Mulder: "Did he kill Erikson?"Ludwig: "He flipped out. Right after the descent, he just flipped out.

name: Je Vois Quelque Chose La Au-Dessous
Text: Recherchez dans votre paquet de cartes FBI et choisissez une carte ALIEN Mot-clé ou ALIEN INVESTIGATION. Montrez cette carte à votre adversaire, ajoutez-la à votre jeu et mélangez le paquet de cartes FBI.English Translation: Search your Bureau deck and choose one keyword ALIEN or ALIEN INVESTIGATION card. Show this card to your opponent, add it to your hand and shuffle your Bureau deck.

name: Jennifer Workman
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or COMPUTER skill check.
Dialogue: Jennifer Workman: "He just seemed nice on the computer."Mulder: "Lauren met him through an on-line service?"Workman: "In one of the chat rooms. You know, where people get together on the internet…to talk about whatever they're into."

name: Jeopardizing The X-Files
Text: Force one opponent to immediately discard their entire hand. Your opponent, at their option, may opt to pay 3 [RP] for each card they do not want to discard.
Dialogue: Deep Throat: "I came here to give you some valuable advice. You are exposing yourself and Agent Scully to unnecessary risk. I advise you to drop the case."Mulder: "I can't do that."Deep Throat: "You have much work to do Agent Mulder. Don't jeopardize the future of your own efforts."

name: Jeraldine Kallenchuk
Text: Draw the top three cards from your Bureau deck. If any of the drawn cards are playable and contain Keyword CONSPIRACY, you may immediately play one (your choice) for zero [CP] Cost. Discard the remaining cards drawn from your Bureau deck.
Dialogue: Mulder: "I'm looking for Mr Kallenchuk."Jeraldine Kallenchuk: "I'm sorry, Mr Kallenchuk is out of town. Perhaps I can help you with something?"

name: Jeremiah Smith
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or adds 3 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check. Alternately, play Jeremiah Smith to immediately heal all damage done to one Agent in the Field. If used in this way, remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: Jeremiah Smith: "I have important information for you, Something your partner has been seeking. It concerns an elaborate plan. A project. And his sister."Scully: "Why didn't you tell me before?"Smith: "I've never spoken to you before, the man you spoke with was an impostor. He was sent here to kill me."

name: Jersey Devil
Dialogue: Mulder: "You should have seen her, she was beautiful."Scully: "Yeah, well she just about ripped your lungs out."

name: Jerusalem, Ohio
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.

name: Jesse Landis
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. If played after Adversary card "2Shy" attacked a Team, the cost of this card is halved.
Dialogue: "I smelled her perfume. That's when I knew he was lying. She was wearing her perfume when she left for her class." - Jesse

name: Jim Ullrich
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or MEDICAL skill check.

name: Jinn's Twisted Wish
Text: This card does not initiate combat. Place this card face up in your opponent's Bureau deck and reshuffle the deck. When this card reaches the top of the deck, your opponent's turn as Active player ends immediately. This card has no effect if it reaches the top of the deck during your opponent's turn as Directed player.
Dialogue: "I wish for peace on earth." - Mulder

name: Joanne Steffen
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER or OBSERVATION skill check.
Dialogue: Joanne Steffen: "Can I help you?"Mulder: "We're with the FBI. We're looking for Ellen Kaminsky."Joanne: "She's in her condo. She just e-mailed me a few minutes ago…"

name: John Barnett Links You To Mulder
Text: This Adversary regenerates (Heals) two points of HEALTH at the beginning of each combat round as long as his HEALTH is not at zero.

name: John Lee Roche
Text: Adds 2 to one Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. Your opponent may pay 3 [CP] to negate this Witness.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Gregory Fremaux
Dialogue: "You choose the one that was your sister, and I'll tell you where she is. Hey, come on, it's a fifty-fifty chance." - John Lee Roche

name: John Mostow
Text: This Card is free if played on a Keyword INSANITY card and Activator requirements are ignored.

name: Johnathon Woods
Text: Attach this card to an OCCULT INVESTIGATION Site during your Case Assignment Phase together with two tokens. The Site stays in the Field as long as this card is attached. Remove a token every time you send a Team of Agents to investigate the Site. Discard this card when the last token is removed.
Dialogue: "The timber museum has been in my family since it was built." - Johnathon Woods

name: Joost Berns
Game Effect: Agent Berns may start the game with the "Uniden Bearcat UBC-125XLT" Equipment card attached at 0 cost. Additionally, if Agent Berns is in the Field, Joseph Patnik can not be played.
Bio: Works at a small software company and is an avid military aircraft enthusiast in his spare time. Joost encountered Agents Mulder and Scully once while investigating an UFO sighting above a military air base of the RNLAF. He likes to think they are out there…somewhere.

name: Jorge Concepción
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OBSERVATION card played
Dialogue: "¡Por favor, no me lastime! ¡Yo tengo mucho miedo!" - Jorge

name: Jose Chung
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION or adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "I spent three months in Klass County and everybody there has a different version of what truly happened. Truth is as subjective as reality. That will help explain why when people talk about their 'UFO experiences,' they always start off with "well now, I know how crazy this is going to sound, but…" -  Jose Chung

name: Jose Chung's "From Outer Space"
Text: Place in an Opponent's Field. Every turn, name one X-File Characteristic (AFFILIATION, METHOD, MOTIVE, or RESULT) during this opponent's Briefing Phase. This Opponent may not ask you this Characteristic question this turn. You may not choose the same characteristic in two consecutive turns. Cards that cause bluffs to be discarded affect this card.

name: Joseph Patnik
Text: Subtract one from all damage sources applied to this Adversary. The Long Range Combat Round is skipped.

name: Josepho's Prophecy
Text: Play this card on a Site. For each card in your hand with the Keyword ALIEN, ALIEN INVESTIGATION, or BEHAVIORAL that you reveal to your opponent, increase the Site's Pre-requisite by 1.
Dialogue: "You want to see your son? You come alone and you follow my instructions to the letter." - Josepho

name: Josie Packard
Text: Josie Packard may attack only one Agent (your choice) in one round of LONG RANGE and one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. All other Agents in the Team also participate in the Combat and may assign damage to Josie as normal.
Dialogue: "Why did you shoot me, Josie?" - Cooper

name: Judy Fairly
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 1 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.
Dialogue: Judy Fairly: "Usually, there'd be something set up in the room to get pictures, tape, whatever."Scully: "Judy, we need you to identify somebody."Mulder: "Is this the man who hired Carina?"Fairly (nodding): "He said that nobody would get hurt."

name: Kallencheck's Salvage Brokers, San Francisco, CA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "Actually I'd rather know who sold you the secret." - Mulder

name: Karin's Dark Sorcery
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. For each Agent that Karin's Dark Sorcery sends to the Hospital you may remove up to 4 [RP] from your opponent's Resource Pool.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Make him stop, Karin!  Tell him what you should have told him twenty years ago. You're not going to take it anymore."

name: Katina Arvidson
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. The Witness's modifier is doubled if played on a Team that includes Delaney Arvidson.
Dialogue: Katina: "We couldn't bring ourselves to tell you. I mean, how do you tell someone your child can do things with her mind? How could anyone ever understand?"Scully: "Believe me, Mrs. Arvidson, we do understand."

name: Keep Your Distance
Text: Unless this card is negated, your opponent may not negate any cards that would send an Agent to The Gulag section of the table (or cards affecting Agents in The Gulag) while this Site is being investigated.
Dialogue: Krycek: "What are they doing?"Mulder: "Looks like some kind of mining camp…Oh! I don't think they're miners."

name: Kenneth Ungar
Text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this Resource when all tokens have been removed.
Dialogue: "Early Kabbalists, they believed that a righteous man could actually create a living being from the Earth itself. Fashioned from mud or clay. This creature could only be brought to life by the power of the word." - Kenneth Ungar

name: Kevin Kryder
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or adds 3 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE skill check. Kevin Kryder may contribute either modifier to any skill check in the field during the turn he is played, even other Agent Team skill checks. At the end of your turn, discard this card.
Dialogue: Kevin Kryder: "Why does he want to hurt me?"Scully: "I don't know Kevin. But I won't let him hurt you. That's a promise."Kryder: "It's because I'm different, isn't it? Why can't I just be like everybody else?"

name: Kevin Morris, A.K.A. The Conduit
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION card is played.

name: Kevlar Vest
Text: The Kevlar Vest will absorb three points of damage. Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to prevent one point of damage. Discard the Vest when all the tokens have been discarded. Excess damage is applied to the Agent as normal.

name: Kevlar Vest
Text: The Kevlar Vest will absorb three points of damage. Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to prevent one point of damage. Discard the Vest when all the tokens have been discarded. Excess damage is applied to the Agent as normal.

name: Kick
Text: Play on any Combatant that can use MARTIAL ARTS or any combatant opposing a stunned opponent. Add 2 to the combatant's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT damage result this round.

name: Kick
Text: Play on any Combatant that can use MARTIAL ARTS or any combatant opposing a stunned opponent. Add 2 to the combatant's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT damage result this round.

name: Kill Switch
Text: This card does not initiate Combat. The Kill Switch creates a distorted reality on the Team of Agents and deals a total of 5 points of damage that may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice). Subtract the COMPUTER skill of each chosen Agent from the damage delivered by the Kill Switch to that Agent.
Dialogue: "What's that smell? Oh, jeez!" - Mulder

name: Kim Hsin
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: Kim Hsin: "We have no money or insurance and now I fear that my father has done something illegal. That he made a mistake and something bad is coming."Mulder: "Who are these men that come to visit your father?"Hsin: "I don't know them. I just know my father say he want out. He want out. But of what, I don't know."

name: Kiss Of The Vampire
Text: Play this card on a Team in the Field that plays a Witness. Discard the Witness card. The Witness actually becomes a lesser vampire that attacks the Team in conjunction with the master vampire, with a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT rating of 3 and a HEALTH rating of 3. LONG RANGE COMBAT will cause no damage to eiter vampire.

name: Kiss Of The Vampire
Text: Play this card on a Team in the Field that plays a Witness. Discard the Witness card. The Witness actually becomes a lesser vampire that attacks the Team in conjunction with the master vampire, with a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT rating of 3 and a HEALTH rating of 3. LONG RANGE COMBAT will cause no damage to either vampire.

name: Kitten's Revenge
Text: The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in Combat. The Kitten's Revenge may use SUBTERFUGE cards. If he attacks Assistant Director Walter Skinner, LRC is skipped.
Dialogue: "Imagine the power of a government that could literally control the minds... of millions of citizens." - Davey James

name: Klass County, Washington
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
Dialogue: I spent three months in Klass County and everybody there has a different version of what truly happened…" -  Jose Chung

name: Knife
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill.

name: Knife
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill.

name: Knowle Rohrer
Text: Knowle Rohrer regenerates (heals) one point of HEALTH at the beginning of each combat round as long as his HEALTH is not at zero.
Dialogue: "Shoot me, Agent Doggett, if you think it'll make a difference this time." - Knowle Rohrer

name: Knuffle Bunny
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill. OCCULT Adversaries must assign damage to this Agent. This card is free if the attached Agent has the Keyword CUTE.
Dialogue: Delaney: "Will you help us find Knuffle Bunny?"Mulder: "Knuffle Bunny?"Katina Arvidson: "Her stuffed animal. It went missing two days ago."

name: Kristen Kilar
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card is played.

name: Kroner, Kansas
Question: You may ask one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Well, this is not without historical precedent. The Old West was full of traveling men who claimed to be rainmakers. The Pueblo Indians even had a rain dance.." - Mulder

name: Krycek Possessed
Text: Play on Agent Krycek when his team fails to successfully investigate a Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION Site (discard the Site). Place two tokens on this card. Remove a token to emit a blast of energy that causes 6 points of damage to all opponents during the Long Range Combat Round. Apply the following permanent modifiers: +1 ALIEN INVESTIGATION, +2 SUBTERFUGE, and +1 HEALTH.

name: Krycek's Amputation
Text: Play on Agent Krycek when he is in the Field and is involved in an ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY skill check. Krycek loses his right arm and all his skills are halved (rounded up). This card cannot be negated and remains attached to Krycek until the end of the game.
Dialogue: "I'm sorry…Nyet! I am American…and I've been falsely accused of spying." - Alex Krycek

name: Krycek's Deadly Ultimatum
Text: Play this card to force any opponent to skip the Healing phase.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "I have a vial that contains a vaccine. Mulder knows of it. His father developed it to fight the alien virus." - Krycek

name: Krycek, The Double Agent
Text: Play on Agent Krycek when he is in the Field and is involved in a skill check. Krycek engages one of the Team's Agents (opponent's choice) in Combat. No other Agents may contribute skills to the combat. If Krycek sends the chosen Agent to the Hospital within two rounds of combat, then Krycek stays on the team, otherwise he is removed from play. While Krycek is affected by this card he is considered a GOVERNMENT, MASTER Adversary. Cards that would cause Krycek to be discard simply negate the combat.

name: Krycek, The Double Agent
Text: Play on Agent Krycek when he is in the Field and is involved in a skill check. Krycek engages one of the Team's Agents (opponent's choice) in Combat. No other Agents may contribute skills to the combat. If Krycek sends the chosen Agent to the Hospital within two rounds of combat, then Krycek stays on the team, otherwise he is removed from play. While Krycek is affected by this card he is considered a GOVERNMENT, MASTER Adversary. Cards that would cause Krycek to be discard simply negate the combat.

name: Kurt Crawford
Text: Play this card to remove the Keyword CANCER from an afflicted Agent. You may have up to five Kurt Crawford cards in your deck.
Dialogue: Mulder: "These women, these women are your birth mothers."Kurt Crawford: "Barren now, from the same procedure that caused their cancer. And now they're left to die, their conditions hastened by the men running this project."

name: Lake Beast
Text: This Adversary may use SUBTERFUGE cards.
Dialogue: "Dr Bailey's not the first person to go missing from Heuvelman's Lake recently. Two weeks ago, a Boy Scout Troop was out here fox hunting. Their troop leader wandered off to relieve himself and hasn't been seen or heard from since." - Mulder

name: Lake Okobogee, Campsite #53 Sioux City IA
Question: You may ask one Motive question.
Dialogue: "You don't believe in UFO's; guess you haven't been out to Lake Okobogee." - Bartender at the Pennsylvania Pub.

name: Lake Okobogee, Campsite #53, Sioux City, IA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.

name: Lake Okobogee, Campsite #53, Sioux City, IA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.

name: Langly
Text: Force one Bluff card attached to a Site to be discarded. If there are several Bluffs at the Site, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly.

name: Langly
Text: Force one Bluff card attached to a Site to be discarded. If there are several Bluffs at the Site, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly.

name: Langly
Text: Negate one Bluff card attached to a Site (before the Bluff cost has been paid). If there are several Bluffs, choose one to be discarded randomly. The Bluff's owner may choose not to play any of the remaining Bluffs attached and discard them.
Dialogue: Langly: "Check it out, Mulder. I had breakfast with the guy that shot John F. Kennedy".Mulder: "Is that so?"Langly: "Old dude, but yeah, said that he was dressed as a cop on the grassy knoll."

name: Langly's Afterlife
Text: Force up to two face-down Bluff cards attached to one or different Sites to be discarded .
Dialogue: "Mulder, it's like I designed heaven. I eat hot dogs and donuts all day long. No one here ever dies of cancer or Alzheimer's. And the Ramones are here, and they don't fight." - Langly

name: Laptop Computer
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's COMPUTER skill.

name: Laptop Computer
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's COMPUTER skill.

name: Las Vegas, NV
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question. If you ask if the MOTIVE is "Control", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.
Dialogue: "You better hope that you never get involved with someone like him." - Duncan Todd

name: Laser Barrier
Text: Play to prevent one Agent assigned to a Site from contributing the Agent's skills to one skill check (your choice) that the Team makes this turn.

name: Laser Barrier
Text: Play to prevent one Agent assigned to a Site from contributing the Agent's skills to one skill check (your choice) that the Team makes this turn.

name: Laser Barrier
Text: Play to prevent one Agent assigned to a Site from contributing the Agent's skills to the one skill check (your choice) that the Team makes this turn.
Dialogue: Colonel Henderson: "We're trying to contain an ecological disaster.Mulder: "That's a lot of firepower just to protect Mother Nature."

name: Laser Targeter
Text: Discard this card to add three to the Agent's LONG RANGE COMBAT skill.

name: Lasioderma Serricorne Outbreak
Text: This card does not initiate Combat. Place target Agent under this card. The Agent may not contribute to any skill check this turn nor generate RES while under this card. At the beginning of your opponent's next Healing phase, remove this card from the game and send the Agent to the Hospital with two damage tokens.
Dialogue: Scully: "...it could be some form of contagious agent, like an insect-borne bacterium..."

name: Last Dial Inquiry
Text: Discard a card from your hand. During your next Briefing Phase, draw two additional cards (in addition to the one you would normally draw). Ignore the effects of any card that prevents you from doing so.
Dialogue: "I need to know the last call made from this booth." - Mulder

name: Latent Image
Text: Make a COMPUTER 4+ skill check. If successful, apply a +1 modifier to the Site skill check.
Dialogue: Agent Pendrell: "You know how an airbag works?"Mulder: "Your car hits something, a bag fills with air, you don't die."Pendrell: "Not air, nitrogen. Now, the latent image… the one we're interested in… is found in the byproduct of that explosion."

name: Laura Palmer's Postmortem Report
Text: Adds two to the Agent's SCIENCES and CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills. You cannot sell this card during the Briefing phase to gain [CP] points.
Dialogue: "Time of death estimated to be between midnight and four AM. What killed her was loss of blood. Numerous shallow wounds, no single one serious enough to have caused death." - Dr. Hayward

name: Laura Palmer's Secret Diary
Text: Adds two to the Agent's BEHAVIORAL and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills. You cannot sell this card during the Briefing Phase to gain [CP] points.
Dialogue: "What we have taped to the page here is a plastic envelope containing a white residue and what looks to be a key to a safety deposit box." - Cooper

name: Lauren Evans Osborne
Text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this resource when all tokens have been discarded.
Dialogue: "Whenever I see him, my vision goes blurry and this…sickness overtakes me. He's always there, no matter where I go." - Lauren, on encountering Slender Man

name: Lawrence Jacoby
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's MEDICAL or adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check.
Dialogue: "I'd like to help you, Agent Cooper. Maybe there is some sort of hula we can do around my doctor-patient confidentiality." - Lawrence Jacoby

name: Legal Representation
Text: Play this card to increase the cost of all Witnesses played at this Site by 2 [RP].
Dialogue: Attorney: "He will not answer any questions regarding his guilt or innocence."Detective Hudak: "I'd be real happy if you'd quit talking right now."

name: Leland Palmer
Text: Leland Palmer's LRC and CRC values are each equal to the number of Agents in the Team currently investigating this Site.
Dialogue: "Your hands are filthy... look, there is dirt way under this fingernail." - Leland Palmer

name: Leonard
Text: This card does not initiate combat. Flip the top card of the Investigating player's Bureau Deck. If it is a Witness card, then both Leonard and the Witness card are removed from the game. If not, then keep flipping until a Witness or 10 cards have been flipped. Flipped cards are placed on the owning player's discard pile.

name: Leonard Betts
Text: This card is free if played on a Keyword CANCER card and Activator requirements are ignored. Leonard Betts regenerates 1 point of HEALTH for each Witness discarded from your hand.
Dialogue: "I'm sorry…but you've got something I need." - Leonard Betts

name: Letter From Samantha
Text: Play this card on a Team of Agents. If the Team makes an ALIEN INVESTIGATION Skill check 5+, look through any player's Bureau deck and remove any one card from the game. Shuffle that Bureau deck afterwards. You may only have one of this card in your Bureau Deck.
Dialogue: "Your sis… Samantha left this at the house for you."

name: Liberty Plaza, Philadelphia, PA
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.
Dialogue: Scully: "Why are we here, Mulder?"Mulder: "Pendrell found asbestos fibers on Owen Sanders' body. And you remove asbestos from an old building before you tear it down. It had to come from somewhere."

name: Lie Detector
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's BEHAVIORAL skill.

name: Lie Detector
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's BEHAVIORAL skill.

name: Lieutenant Brophy
Game Effect: Agent Brophy may use MARTIAL ARTS cards. He may add 1 to any damage caused by EQUIPMENT card attached to him that have a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT or LONG RANGE COMBAT modifier.
Bio: Agent Brophy, an FBI SWAT Lieutenant, worked with Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully, to apprehend the hit man Robert Modell, a.k.a. "Pusher".

name: Lieutenant Jack Sheaffer
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE skill check.
Dialogue: Lt. Sheaffer: "The enemy sees an American recon plane, they start shooting; they see a flying saucer from another galaxy… they hesitate. You know what happens to most people after seeing a UFO?"Mulder: "They experience missing time."

name: Lieutenant Kraskow
Game Effect: Treat Lieutenant Kraskow's LRC skill as 4 if the number of agents in his Team is 4 or more.
Bio: Lieutenant Kraskow is a SWAT team leader managing the crime scene during a bank robbery. He collaborates with FBI Agent Skinner, who is seeking his trapped agents, Mulder and Scully.

name: Life From Ashes
Text: Play this card to heal all damage done to an Agent only if their HEALTH is reduced to zero after a Combat. The Agent can still contribute with their skills to the Site skill check this turn.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: "I want you to rise. Rise up and heal!" - Samuel

name: Lightning Strikes
Text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one keyword EVOLUTIONARY Adversary.
Dialogue: "That's as clear as glass. Do you know what we manufacture in Connorville? What one of our little local commodities is? We make lightning. At the Astadourian Lightning Observatory out on Route 4. A hundred ionized rods pointing at the sky, designed to stimulate lightning." -  Sheriff Teller

name: Lil the Dancer
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "Right, which is probably why Lil was wearing a red wig meaning we are headed into a dangerous situation." - Agent Desmond

name: Limited Choices
Text: Play this card to cause the Investigating player to discard X number of cards (chosen randomly) from his hand. X = [CP] cost paid.

name: Limited Choices
Text: Play this card to cause the Investigating player to discard X number of cards (chosen randomly) from his hand. X = [CP] cost paid.
Dialogue: "No one believes me. I'm an annoyance to my superiors, a joke to my peers. They call me Spooky. Spooky Mulder." - Mulder

name: Linda Bowman
Text: Play on a Team of three or more Agents investigating a Site. Only Agents with at least one of the skills listed in that Site prerequisite may participate in any skill check or Combat at this Site.
Dialogue: "After what they've done, do you think I'd let them get away with this? I'm gonna finish what you started." - Linda Bowman

name: Liquid Alien
Text: When this card is played on a Team of Agents, they make an ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check of 4+. If successful, discard this card. If not, place this card on an Agent (your choice). That Agent now attacks the Team with the CLOSE RANGE COMBAT, LONG RANGE COMBAT and HEALTH of the Liquid Alien. When Combat ends, the affected Agent is reduced to zero Health.
Dialogue: "Johansen did what he had to. That's war. Some are sacrificed so others can live." -  Irradiated Submariner

name: Living Machine
Text: Fight Combat as normal except skip LONG RANGE COMBAT and go straight to CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. Agents must use their COMPUTER skill as their value in CRC. If an Agent has no COMPUTER skill, his value is 1.

name: Living Machine
Text: Fight Combat as normal except skip LONG RANGE COMBAT and go straight to CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. Agents must use their COMPUTER skill as their value in CRC. If an Agent has no COMPUTER skill, his value is 1.

name: Living Scarecrow
Text: The cost to play this card is 3 [CP] if the Site Prerequisite is OCCULT INVESTIGATION. LRC and CRC attacks cause only half damage (rounded up) to this Adversary.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Like other effigies, the scarecrow is an unintelligent creation, classically used by farmers to protect their crops."Stephen Arvidson: "Right. Except this thing wasn't just warding off birds. It killed our neighbors."

name: Lizzy Gill
Game Effect: Lizzy Gill allows you to choose to add to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resource Pool during the Briefing Phase. Treat Lizzy Gill as RES 2 if she is in the same Team as Agent Scully. If so, Scully's HEALTH value is decreased by one.
Bio: Lizzy Gill was introduced by Margaret Scully to assist during Scully's pregnancy. Later revealed as a scientist working for a faction interested in Scully's baby's genome. Despite suspicion, her actions imply Scully's baby is a natural miracle.

name: Lobby Guard
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.
Dialogue: Robert Modell: "Excuse me…where might I find the Computer Records Section?"Lobby Guard: "F-Fourth floor…west wing."Modell: "Thank you."

name: Lock Pick
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's SUBTERFUGE rating.

name: Lombard Research Facility, Allentown, PA
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "You guys ever been to the Lombard Research Facility? Well, pick out something black and sexy and prepare to do some funky poaching." - Mulder, to the Lone Gunmen

name: Lone No More
Text: Negate one of these cards (your choice): 'Byers', 'Frohike', 'Langly', 'Call on us more often', 'No one so paranoid', 'Three words, one solution', 'The Lone Gunman', 'The Lone Gunmen' or 'Three of a kind'.
Dialogue: "They meant so much to me. I'm not sure if they really knew." - Scully

name: Long-Range Combat Training
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal and in addition has a +2 in LRC skill. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.
Dialogue: "Are we talking kung-fu movies, Mulder?" -Scully

name: Lord of the Flies
Text: At the beginning of each combat round, you may choose one Agent. That Agent is webbed and cannot attack or use abilities that round. If that Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0 by the end of the Combat, you may draw one extra card at the start of your next Briefing Phase.
Dialogue: "Your mouth, your tongue... there's something wrong with you." - Natalie Gordon

name: Lorraine Kelleher
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 2 one Team's OBSERVATION skill check.
Dialogue: Lorraine Kelleher: "She called me last night. She said that she'd met someone in a bar who was interested in a transaction. I took his credit card."Mulder: "Then you have his name?"Kelleher: "Yes. Walter Skinner."

name: Los Angeles, CA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.

name: Los Angeles, CA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.

name: Los Angeles, CA
Question: You may ask one Affiliation question or one Method question.
Dialogue: "Their need is insatiable, but murdering for blood risks exposure and capture. If my profile of previous cases holds true, they've been living in the city and working near blood products for the past month." - Mulder

name: Losing Your Tail
Text: Play this card at the end of the Case Assignment Phase, after Bluffs have been played. Return any one Site to your hand. Bluffs attached to this Site are moved to the owning player's Discard pile.
Dialogue: Agent Morris: "Relax, we know where she's going… St. Croix. Caribbean Air flight 519. Takes off at five after seven. Gate's in the other terminal.."Scully: "I'd like a ticket on the 6:30 flight to San Juan."

name: Lost and Found
Text: Play to force your opponent to discard one card played this turn (your choice), except Sites and Agents. Alternately, you may select one card from your opponent's Discard Pile and play it immediately at no cost. Place it in its owner's Discard Pile after it has been used. In both instances, X = the [RP] cost of the selected card.

name: Lottie Holoway
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Loudoun County, Virginia
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "I want him in a car with a cage! Loudoun County Unit, whatever. I'll ride shotgun." -  Agent Frank Burst

name: Lt. Brian Tillman, Aubrey Police Department
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword EQUIPMENT or COMBAT cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Lt. Brian Tillman, Aubrey Police Department
Game Effect: Place 1 [RP] on this card. This [RP] may be used to pay for any Keyword EQUIPMENT or COMBAT cards. If you use this [RP], replace it during your Briefing Phase.

name: Lt. Colonel Marcus Aurelius Belt
Text: Negates one ALIEN CREATURE.

name: Lt. Colonel Victor Stans
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION or SUBTERFUGE skill check, or play this card to negate the Adversary "The Walk."

name: Lt. Terry Wilmer
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check once during your turn. While in play, you may Discard this Resource during your opponent's turn to play the "Alien Bounty Hunter" at no cost, Activator requirements permitting.
Dialogue: "A man came. He...he sealed most of the men below decks without any air and...and then he started to execute the rest of us. Every…they're all dead." - Lt. Terry Wilmer

name: Lucky Keyword Unlock
Text: Play on one Team in the Field. If the Team makes a COMPUTER skill check 5+, then they may add 2 to any Site skill check. Discard this card after you have used the modifier.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Vegreville."Kurt Crawford: "We're in."

name: Lucy Gives Up Her Life For Amy
Text: Play this card and choose one Agent to send to the Hospital immediately with zero Health. All Bluff currently affecting that Agent Team (revealed or unrevealed) are discarded.
Dialogue: Mulder: "She drowned, didn't she?"Scully: "They found five liters of water in her lungs."Mulder: "She saved Amy's life."

name: Lucy Householder
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION or adds 1 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check, or play this card when your opponent is about to remove one of your cards from the game. Remove this card instead.

name: Luis Cardinal
Text: Luis Cardinal can attack one Agent (your choice) for one round of LONG RANGE COMBAT and CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. If he attacks Assistant Director Walter Skinner, LRC is skipped and two rounds of CRC take place. If Agent Alex Krycek is attacked, all of his Equipment is removed and discarded.
Dialogue: Skinner: "Is there a problem here?"Luis Cardinal: "Yeah, these is a big problem… Chupa dura amigo…"

name: Lula Phillips
Text: Play this card after an Adversary sends any Agent to the Hospital or removes an Agent from the game. Place five tokens in your [CP] pool.

name: Lula Phillips

name: Lulu Pfeiffer

Dialogue: "What are you doing here?" - Lulu Pfeiffer

name: Lurking Coywolf
Dialogue: "It's a mix of Canis Latras and Canis Lupus. It's a hybrid coyote-wolf." - Mulder

name: Lurking in Plain Sight
Text: Force an opponent Team to make an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check. If they fail, apply a -3 modifier to the Site skill check and your opponent must discard all Witness cards from their hand.
Dialogue: Mulder: "What is it, Scully?"Scully: "I thought I saw someone, watching from over there. Did you see him?"Mulder: "No, but then again my eyesight's not what it used to be."

name: M.R.I.

name: Madam Zirinka
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check.
Dialogue: Madam Zirinka: "I think the whole town's lost its marbles. I should've been the first to see it coming, but, it's hard being a small business owner. I mean…you should see the paperwork."Mulder: "What do you mean 'seen it coming'?"Zirinka: "Well we're heading into a rare planetary alignment where Mercury, Mars and Uranus are extreme influences."

name: Maggi Forrester
Text: Play this card to reduce the Site Prerequisite of any one COMPUTER or OCCULT INVESTIGATION Site by 1. This card is free is played at "Forks High School".
Dialogue: "Forks has always been connected to a darker side of the world." - Maggi Forrester

name: Maggie Holvey

name: Magical Mystery Tour
Text: Decrease all of the skills levels on one Agent (your choice) by 2 for this turn only. Then, regardless of whether the Site Prerequisite is met or not, move the Agent to the Hospital with one damage token.
Dialogue: "Dude, I was on fire!." - Mulder

name: Mahan Propulsion Laboratory, Colson, WA

name: Mahan Propulsion Laboratory, Colson, WA

name: Maintain Deniability
Text: For the remainder of this turn, your opponent may only play Keyword GOVERNMENT cards.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Are you saying that our government wants these officers dead?...Why would they ask us to protect them?"Marita Covarrubias: "Because they know you can't."

name: Maitreya's Virtual Menace
Text: Maitreya may use MARTIAL ARTS Combat cards. The damage dealt by her on any Agent can be considered "virtual": the Agents' controller may remove 1 point of damage (1 token) from any Agent damaged by Maitreya for each 2 [RP]'s spent on that Agent. This action may prevent those Agents to be sent to the Hospital.
Dialogue: Scully: "She's input herself into the game. We have to download her."

name: Major Garland Briggs
Game Effect: If a Team including Garland Briggs is attacked by a PRIMORDIAL or an OCCULT Adversary, you may choose to engage only Garland Briggs with that Adversary. After the Combat, discard the Adversary card.
Bio: Major Garland Briggs was a principled U.S. Air Force officer who oversaw a secret paranormal research site in Twin Peaks. Committed to truth and duty, he aided Agent Cooper against supernatural threats and sacrificed himself battling evil beyond our world.

name: Make History
Text: Negate any one Keyword ALIEN or Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION card.
Dialogue: The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "A living E.B.E. could advance Bill Mulder's project by decades."Deep Throat: "Security Resolution Council 1013 states, 'Any country capturing such an entity is responsible for its immediate extermination'."

name: Make The Deal
Text: Play this card on one Site card during the Case Assignment Phase. No Bluffs may be played on this Site except for Bluffs which would negate this card. Discard this card when the Site card is discarded.
Dialogue: Scully: " I asked Skinner to make the deal. But not to hand over the tape until you agree to it."Mulder: "I'm sorry about your sister, Scully."Scully: " I just need to know if she's going to be alright."

name: Making Sacrifices
Text: Play this card to allow one Team of Agents to investigate two Sites this turn. In the Debriefing Phase, each Agent takes 2 damage. If this lowers any Agent's HEALTH to zero, move them to the Hospital.
Dialogue: Scully: "Where are you going?"Mulder: "If I told you, you'd never let me go."Scully: "Mulder you haven't slept in almost 24 hours."Mulder: "Call me if you find anything."

name: Manhole Surprise
Text: Play this card to search though your Bureau deck for any one Keyword BLUFF card. Add the card to your hand and reveal it to your opponent. Shuffle your deck.
Dialogue: "Oh, crap!" - Mulder

name: Manipulating The Circumstances
Text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one Adversary. Additionally, the Adversary's cost is halved (rounded up).
Dialogue: The Cigarette-Smoking Man: "There's nothing here but holes in the ground, Mr Mulder."Mulder: "The UFO's here. That's what Krycek was after, isn't it?"The Cigarette-Smoking Man: "Krycek? Alex Krycek disappeared five months ago."Scully: "We saw bodies back there. Men who had been exposed to high levels of radiation."The Cigarette-Smoking Man: "You saw nothing."

name: Manipulating the Flock
Text: Place this card next to a Site card as a Resource. The next card your opponent plays at this Site must be discarded with no effect after it is paid for, except for cards that negate this card or Combat cards. Then, discard this card. If no such card is played, this card remains in play until the Site is discarded.
Dialogue: "I'm telling you the truth. I only want to help these people." - Absalom

name: Marcus Duff, INS
Text: Adds 2 to onr Team's BUREAUCRACY or adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check, or play this card to return "Samuel Aboah" to the bottom of the owning player's Bureau Deck.
Dialogue: Marcus Duff: "I assist people from that part of the world where I came from fifteen years ago."Mulder: " Well, we're looking for somebody that came a little more recently than that. On a flight from Burkina Faso?"

name: Margaret Scully
Text: Adds one to one Team's MEDICAL or SCIENCES skill check. This card may be played for zero [RP] and treated as a +4 to the appropriate skill if Agent Dana Scully is in the Hospital or if the Witness card Melissa Scully has been removed from the game.

name: Margi Kleinjan
Text: This card may be played on a Site at which the "Terri Roberts" Adversary card has been played, ignoring Activator requirements. When this occurs, both Adversaries attack simultaneously (treat as one combat) and double both cards' LRC, CRC, and HEALTH. Triple both cards' LRC, CRC and HEALTH if the Agents are using OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill.

name: Marita Covarrubias

Bio: Assistant to one of the Special Representatives of the of the UN Secretary General, Marita Covarrubias is a mysterious character with little know background who provided top secret information to Agent Fox Mulder, whilst working with The Cigarette-Smoking Man.

name: Marita Covarrubias, UN Representative
Game Effect: Marita's ALIEN INVESTIGATION and SUBTERFUGE skills are increased by one if she and Agent Alex Krycek are on the same Team, and her BUREAUCRACY is reduced by one.
Bio: While employed as an assistant to one of the Special Representatives of UN Secretary General, Marita Covarrubias covertly provided Agent Fox Mulder with classified information. Unbeknownst to Mulder, Marita was an intelligence operative for the Cigarette - Smoking Man.

name: Martin Alpert
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or BUREAUCRACY skill check. While this card is in play, the Witness card "Harold Spuller" may be played for free.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Has he ever been a problem?"Martin Alpert: "Harold? No. He has a tendency to get a little worked up."Mulder: "Do you think I could talk to him?"Alpert: "Yeah, sure."

name: Martin Shultz
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. This card is free if played on a Team that includes Yumi Sagiuchi Shultz.
Dialogue: Martin Shultz: "Are you the FBI Agents my sister contacted?"Scully: "That's right. I admit we were reluctant to travel all this way, but she insisted that your situation here warranted our attention."

name: Marty Glenn
Text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this resource when all tokens have been discarded.
Dialogue: "It's not magic. It's your crappy cologne. Who's that with you?" - Marty Glenn

name: Masked Identity
Text: Play this card any time during a Combat on any Adversary. If the Adversary's HEALTH was not reduced to zero yet, you may allow that Adversary to end Combat and return the card to your hand, but you cannot play the Adversary again this turn.
Dialogue: "I like to say whoever God didn't get around to creating in his own image, it's our job to recreate in ours." - Doctor Kaplan

name: Mass Grave
Text: Play this card to immediately add one [CP] to your pool for every two [RP] the Investigating Team uses at this Site.

name: Massive Internal Damage
Text: Play on any Agent that has taken four or more points of damage from a single damage source. That Agent must go to the Hospital immediately and may no longer participate in the combat. The Agent may not leave the Hospital until fully healed. Subtract 4 from the Agent's Cost. If the result is zero or less, the Agent is removed from the game. (Agents Lamana, Willis, Purdue, and Weiss are immune to this effect).

Your opponent must then revel an additional Characteristic from the same category that also does not apply to their X-File (e.g., "The Result is not Death". Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: "A path is formed by laying one stone at a time." - The Giant

name: Maya - Coastal Northwest Vampire
Text: LONG RANGE COMBAT will cause no damage to the Vampire. This Adversary gains +1 CLOSE RANGE COMBAT for each subsequent round of CRC that her HEALTH is no at zero.
Dialogue: Scully: "There was blood throughout her digestive system, but the blood was from an animal, not a human."David Pease: "These monsters' only motivation is to drink human blood to survive. If it's been starving itself of human blood, that would explain why it went into a frenzy when I was wounded."

name: Meaning Emerges
Text: Play this card immediately after your opponent has finished drawing cards in the Briefing Phase. Place this card next to your X-File with two tokens on it. Discard one token to examine your opponent's hand. When there are no tokens left, discard this card.
Dialogue: "It's not a puzzle at all. It's a map." - Andy Brennan

Dialogue: "We have come together in this life, this time. Only to meet in passing." - Melissa Riedal-Ephesian

name: Melissa Scully
Text: Adds two to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check. Alternately, play this card when Agent Dana Scully is damaged in combat. Dana Scully takes no damage and Melissa Scully is damaged instead. Remove this card from the game.

name: Men In Black
Text: Play this card in the Field during your opponents' Case Assignment Phase. You may place Bluff cards under this card face down at any time. No more than three cards may be under this card at any one time. During his Case Assignment Phase you may play cards stored under this card on any Site in the Field for 2 [CP] less.

name: Menial Assignments
Text: Place this card on one opposing Agent. Place three tokens on this card. While this card is in play, the affected Agent may only contribute to Site skill checks using EVIDENCE COLLECTION or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION as a Prerequisite. Remove on token during your opponent's Debriefing Phase. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
Dialogue: Skinner: "Agent Mulder, would you please inform the room as to why you regard your homicide case in New Jersey as meaningless?"Mulder: "It seemed to me like a simple drugland body dump. Not the type of case the FBI normally wastes its time and manpower on."

name: Message From The Stars
Text: Negate one ALIEN Adversary. In addition, if the Team makes an ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check 6+, they may ask either one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.

name: Messages From Beyond
Text: Play this card to draw four cards, then place any two cards from your hand on top of your Bureau deck or in your discard pile.
Dialogue: "Close your eyes and let them come to you. They will come to you if you're ready to see." - Harold Piller

name: Michael Kryder
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or OBSERVATION skill check, or you may play this card to look at all Adversaries in opponent's hand.

name: Michael Lee Kritschgau
Game Effect: Place one token on Kritschgau. Discard one token to search through your Bureau deck and add a keyword BUREAUCRACY Witness card to your hand. Show it to your opponent and shuffle the deck. Additionally, if he is on the same Team as Agent Mulder, change Mulder's Keyword BELIEVER to SKEPTIC.
Bio: Michael Kritschgau was an employee of the Department of Defense. He stole a core sample from an FBI lab and later revealed Mulder that UFO conspiracy was a cover-up for military experiments.

name: Michael Myers
Text: This Adversary regenerates (Heals) two points of HEALTH at the beginning of each combat round as long as his HEALTH is not at 0. Michael Myers may use SUBTERFUGE cards. If killed in combat, return Myers to your Bureau deck and shuffle.
Dialogue: Scully: "You're the Oxford psychologist. What are we up against?"Mulder: "I'm not convinced what we're dealing with is entirely human."

name: Michel the Clubgoer
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OBSERVATION skill check. Alternately, play this card when one of your Agents is the target of "Brother Martin is Attracted to You". Discard Michel to negate the Adversary.
Dialogue: "I saw her in her clothes and she looked like...she looked like a man." - Michel

name: Michelle Fazekas
Text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's RES value during the Briefing Phase if that Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.
Dialogue: "They appear to be human, but whoever left these uses the balls of his feet more like an animal." - Michelle Fazekas

name: Michelle Generoo
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword COMPUTER or BUREAUCRACY card is played.

name: Michelle Wilkes
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's MEDICAL skill check once per turn. If your opponent plays an EVOLUTIONARY Adversary while this card is in play, Michelle Wilkes is negated and removed from the game.
Dialogue: "You know how they say some people can just look at you and tell you what's wrong? Leonard could do that." - Michelle Wilkes

name: Mid-Air Abduction
Text: Play to force the Investigating player to discard all Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION and OBSERVATION cards in their hand. In addition, any and all Witnesses played at this Site are immediately afflicted with the Keyword ABDUCTEE (due to residual radiation) even after this card is resolved.
Dialogue: "You're saying the man sitting in seat 13 - F was abducted mid - flight without any depressurization of the cabin, without any effect on the plane." - Mike Millar, NTSB

name: Midnight Chase
Text: Play this card on any Agent to immediately skip one combat round for that Agent. The Agent takes no damage that round and may not deal any damage either.
Dialogue: "Well, whatever it is you do believe, Scully…when you walk into that room nothing sacred will hold." - Mulder

name: Midnight Inquisitor
Text: Discard this card to draw three cards from your Bureau deck during the requisition phase.
Dialogue: “Just give me my lotto ticket and, uh, a pint of malt scotch whiskey." - Clyde Bruckman

name: Migrant Workers Camp, San Joaquin, CA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Fortean events have been linked to alien encounters, cattle mutilations,the kind of exsanguinated animal carcass you were just looking at."Scully: "And the victim, Maria Dorantes, did she die in a similar fashion?"

name: Mike Millar, NTSB
Game Effect: Treat Mike Millar as a RES 2 if he is in the Field. If Millar is in the same Team as Agent Mulder and/or Agent Scully, he gains +1 to his ALIEN INVESTIGATION and OBSERVATION skills.
Bio: Mike Millar is a member of the National Transportation Safety Board who oversaw the investigation of the fatal crash of Flight 549. He disagreed with Agent Mulder's theory that aliens were involved in the downing of the plane.

name: Military Police
Text: Play to immediately detain one opposing Agent (your choice) by placing the Agent underneath this card. The Agent may not contribute to any skill checks while detained. When Combat ends, the Agent is moved to the Bureau (undamaged) and may not generate RES on the next turn.

name: Miller's Grove, Massachusetts
Question: You may ask one RESULT question.

name: Mind Control
Text: Play on any OCCULT or EVOLUTIONARY Adversary to cause one Agent to allocate all damage to a target of the Adversary's choice this round (including other Agents).

name: Mind Control

name: Minister Diabria
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your Pool every time a Keyword BUREAUCRACY or SUBTERFUGE card is played.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Thank you for seeing me at such a late hour, sir."Diabria: "I did not have much of a choice in this matter. Someone from the United Nations spoke to the ambassador directly. What's so important that it can't wait?"Mulder: "With all due respect, sir, I think you already know."

name: Minneapolis, MN

Dialogue: "I think people are looking hard for miracles… so hard that maybe they make themselves see what they want to see." - Mulder

name: Misclassified Case

name: Misty Nagata
Text: Attach this card to Assistant Director Skinner. Adds 1 to Skinner's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill once per turn. Discard this card when Skinner's HEALTH is reduced to zero.
Dialogue: Misty Nagata: "I can look up the tracking number."Skinner: "That would be a big help to me, Misty. And maybe to Jane."

name: Mojo Bag

name: Momentary Connection
Text: Play this card on a Team including Agent Fox Mulder and Agent Dana Scully. Choose one of these Agents to use one of the other Agent's skills during a single skill check decreased by one (i.e. Scully could use Mulder's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill as 3). You can only have one of this card in your Bureau deck.
Dialogue: "Ow! Something stung me." - Scully

name: Mona Wustner
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's COMPUTER or adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: Mona Wustner: "They should have left it buried. None of this would have happened."Mulder: "Do you believe the bones are cursed?"Mona: "Might as well be."

name: Monongahela Medical Center, Pittsburgh, PA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question. If you ask if the MOTIVE is "Survival", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.
Dialogue: "It should probably be noted that when Mr. Betts arrived here last night he was sans head. He was decapitated when his ambulance crashed." - Mulder

name: Moral Quagmire
Text: Attach this card to either an Agent in the Bureau section or one that is investigating a Site. The Agent is afflicted with the Keyword TRAITOR and may only contribute to SUBTERFUGE and Combat skill checks until this card is removed. Discard this card when an Agent is part of a Team that successfully investigates a Site. This card is free if played on a Keyword NEUTRAL Agent.
Dialogue: Skinner: "What did you have me cover up?"The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "I think the less you know the better, under the circumstances."

name: More Men in Black
Text: Force an opponent Team to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If unsuccessful, the Site Prerequisite is increased by 1 for each Agent on the Team that does not have a SUBTERFUGE skill value.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Where's the guy who looks like Alex Trebek?"MIB Ray: "Why does everyone keep saying that? Dude looked nothing like him!"Mulder: "Looked? As in past tense? What happened? Did he retire?"MIB Rei: "Nah man. Pancreatic cancer, if you can believe that?"

name: Mortality Imminent
Text: Place this card on an opposing Agent afflicted with the Keyword CANCER. The Agent is immediately moved to the Hospital (if not already there) and must remain in the Hospital until the Keyword CANCER is removed.
Dialogue: "What I couldn't tell Agent Mulder, what I had only learned myself, was that the cancer which had been diagnosed in me several months earlier had metastasized..." - Scully

name: Mostow's Sketches
Text: Attach this card to an Agent in the Field. The Agent may attack any Team investigating a Site during his opponent's Investigation Phase. If the Agent is Negated, discard this card. If the Agent is reduced to zero HEALTH, remove the Agent from the game.

name: Mostow's Studio, Washington, D.C.
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.

name: Mothman's Lair
Text: The Mothman is negated if the Team it attacks makes a successful SUBTERFUGE +4 skill check. The LRC round is skipped. For the first round of CRC, the chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. The Mothman may use SUBTERFUGE cards.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Witnesses described them as primitive looking men with red piercing eyes. Became known as the "moth men." I've got an X-File dating back to 1952 on it."

name: Mount Weather Complex, Bluemont, VA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question. Prerequisites of this card may not be changed by any card.
Dialogue: "Would you defend a man who believes in aliens against the FBI and the military? " - Mulder

name: Mr. C, The Shadow of Cooper
Text: Mr. C's LRC, CRC and HEALTH values become equal to those of any one Agent in the target Team (your choice), until the end of this Combat. Move that Agent to the Hospital with 0 HEALTH. Mr. C attacks the remaining Agents in a normal Combat sequence that lasts one LRC and one CRC round.
Dialogue: "What brings you back to Twin Peaks, Agent Cooper?" - Sheriff Truman

name: Mr. Chuckle Teeth
Text: When you play Mr. Chuckleteeth, your opponent must choose two Agents. Send all other Agents are sent to the Hospital with zero HEALTH. Then, discard this Adversary.
Dialogue: "Mr. Chuckleteeth, Happy as can be. Mister Chuckleteeth, won't you play with me. When I'm feeling lonely, lonely as can be, Oh, Mister Chuckleteeth, won't you play with me." - Mulder

name: Mr. Green
Text: Mr. Green may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards. Each Agent wounded by Mr. Green may not contribute to any skill check this turn.
Dialogue: "My parents were killed by those men on the street. They're hunting me now." - William

name: Mr. Jackpots
Text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase on a Team of Agents in the Field to double the RES produced by each Agent in that Team for this turn. Discard this card afterward.
Dialogue: "HELLO-O-O-O-O" - Doogie

name: Mr. Y's Loyal Servant
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT is skipped. This Adversary may attack a Team of Agents in the Bureau. During the Combat, the Bureau is considered to have a single Characteristic SITE Keyword. You may choose any one (e.g., RESULT SITE) and play this Adversary in the Bureau instead, following the usual Combat rules.
Dialogue: "Tha man they just wheeled out on a gurney... I know that man." - Mulder

name: Mr. Y's Manipulation
Text: Play this card on a MULTI Site card. If the Team successfully investigates the Site after meeting the Site Prerequisite, you may choose the type of question your opponent may ask from the options listed on the Site card.
Dialogue: "You can't keep this secret for long." - Mr. Y

name: Mrs. Mulder
Text: Adds zero to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BEHAVIORAL skill check. If this card is used in a successful Site investigation, the owning player may ask "Is your X-File's Affiliation Government?" in addition to the Site question for zero cost.

Text: Puppet may wait until his opponents declare they have played all of the COMBAT cards that they intend to, then Puppet may play COMBAT cards. No other COMBAT cards may be played after Puppet's. This card is free and Activator requirements are ignored if it is played on a Keyword INSANITY card.

name: Pusher
Text: Each combat round, the controller of the Team opposing Pusher must choose odd or even. Flip over the top card from the Bureau deck. If the cost matches his guess (odd or even) continue Combat as normal. If the guess is incorrect, Pusher may allocate one Agent's damage to any one target (including other Agents).
Dialogue: "But the mechanism of suggestion is the same. It's just a lot more powerful in this case. I mean, this guy calls himself 'Pusher'; can't we take that to mean that he 'pushes' his will onto other people?" -  Mulder

name: Puzzles Within Puzzles
Text: Play to negate one Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card.

name: Puzzles Within Puzzles
Text: Play to negate one Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card.

name: Pvt. McAlpin, Zombie
Text: LONG RANGE COMBAT attacks cause only half damage (round up) to the Zombie.

name: Pvt. McAlpin, Zombie

name: Pvt. McAlpin, Zombie
Text: Long Range Combat attacks cause only half damage (round up) to the Zombie.
Dialogue: Scully: "He's non-verbal, non-responsive to voice, touch or pain. The neurologist suspects he's suffered a severe concussion in the crash resulting in amnesia." Mulder: "That's a plausible diagnosis only I'm more interested in how he came back to life."

name: Quarantine Zone
Text: Place this card on top of an opponent's Site and place two tokens on it. Remove a token during each of their following Briefing Phases. While this card is in play, the Site cannot be resolved. The Team may not move or contribute their skills until the last token is removed, except for Agents equipped with a "Biohazard Suit".
Dialogue: "Get on your cell phone and have a hazmat team assembled." - Mulder

name: Queequeg
Text: Discard Queequeg to negate any one PRIMORDIAL or EVOLUTIONARY Adversary. Each player may only have one of this card in their decks.

name: Quick Strike
Text: Play on any combatant during one CRC round. That combatant will deal damage to their opponents first. If the HEALTH value of any opponent reaches zero after applying modifiers or healing cards, that combatant is sent to the Hospital and cannot deal any damage back that round.
Dialogue: "Don't telegraph that left, Dre. Stevie Wonder would see that one coming. You're fighting the FBI now, Dre. Fight smart. Go!" - Skinner's coach

name: Quid Pro Quo
Text: If the Team investigating this Site successfully meets the Site Prerequisite, you must reveal one of your X-File's characteristics to your opponent (their choice), and your opponent must reveal the same characteristic to you. Remove this card from play. You may only have one of this card in your deck.
Dialogue: "I thought that you were dead." - Monica Reyes

name: Radioactive Area
Text: Increase a Site Prerequisite by one point (i.e., Prerequisite: Skill 5+ becomes Skill 6+). In addition, if the Team fails the skill check, each Agent on the Team takes one point of damage. If one of the Agents has a "Geiger Counter", this card has no effect.

name: Radioactive Area
Text: Increase a Site Prerequisite by one point (i.e., Prerequisite: Skill 5+ becomes Skill 6+). In addition, if the Team fails the skill check, each Agent on the Team takes one point of damage. If one of the Agents has a "Geiger Counter", this card has no effect.

name: Ratboy's Prosthesis
Text: Attach this card to an Agent with the Keyword NEUTRAL or a SUBTERFUGE skill of 1+. As long as the Agent in the Field, their SUBTERFUGE skill value is increased by 1 for each point of damage affecting them.
Dialogue: Krycek: "I am only here, Comrade, to congratulate you on a fine job."Vassily Peskow: Thank you."(Translated from Russian)

name: Ray Pearce, Metal Fury
Text: LONG RANGE COMBAT attacks cause only half damage (rounded up) to Ray Pearce.
Dialogue: "I've reviewed Ray's medical records from the VA. What his wife was calling Gulf War Syndrome is nothing of the kind. His entire cellular makeup was affected by exposure to some non-identifiable contaminant-- a metal." - Scully

name: Reading The Signs
Text: Play on any Team in the Field. If the Team makes an OCCULT INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check, they may take 2 [CP] from their opponent's Conspiracy Pool and add them to their Resource Pool.

name: Reading The Signs
Text: Play on any Team in the Field. If the Team makes an OCCULT INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check, they may take 2 [CP] from their opponent's Conspiracy Pool and add them to their Resource Pool.

name: Reconnaissance
Text: Play this card during the Investigation Phase. Make an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check to search through your Bureau Deck and draw one Keyword WEAPON or ARMOR Equipment card. Attach the Equipment to an Agent at half-cost (rounded up), ignoring Activator requirements.
Dialogue: Scully: "Are these vests absolutely necessary, deputy?"Deputy Barney Paster: "I've seen them fire muskets before. I, for one, am not getting taken out by some antique."

name: Record of Atrocities
Text: Play to lower a Site Prerequisite by 2.
Dialogue: Scully: "And what they can't cover, they apologize for. Apology has become policy."Mulder: "I don't need an apology for the lies. I don't care about the fictions they create to cover their crimes. I want them held accountable for what did happen. I want an apology for the truth."

name: Red Tape
Text: Play during the Briefing Phase to prevent one opponent from drawing any cards during the remainder of this turn.

name: Red Tape
Text: Play during the Briefing Phase to prevent one opponent from drawing any cards during the remainder of this turn.

name: Red-Haired Man
Text: This Adversary is able to use SUBTERFUGE and MARTIAL ARTS cads. If you opponent has correctly guessed two of your X-File's characteristics, the cost to play this card is 3 [CP].

name: Regeneration
Text: Play immediately after discarding an EVOLUTIONARY Adversary as a result of either Combat or a Negate effect. The Adverary is returned to the Field at no cost and may attack the Team again.
Dialogue: Mulder: "What if this man's life force, his Chi, whatever you want to call it, somehow retained a blueprint of the actual man himself? Guiding rapid growth not as cancer, but as regeneration?"Scully: "You think that Leonard Betts regrew his head?"

name: Rejuvenating Caves
Text: Play this card next to the X-File you have chosen. Place ten tokens on this card. Beginning on your opponent's next turn you may take up to two tokens from this card and place them in your [CP] pool. The tokens become [CP] tokens. When all counters have been removed, discard this card.

name: Rejuvenating Caves
Text: Play this card next to the X-File you have chosen. Place ten tokens on this card. Beginning on your opponent's next turn you may take up to two tokens from this card and place them in your [CP] pool. The tokens become [CP] tokens. When all counters have been removed, discard this card.

name: Relentless Pursuit
Text: Play to prevent the opposing player from drawing cards after the player has paid, but before the cards are drawn. X = The number of cards that the opposing player has paid to draw.

name: Relentless Pursuit

name: Rending Claws

name: Rending Claws
