name: Renewed Threat
Text: Play this card at the end of a Combat round on any Adversary card you control to return that Adversary card back to your hand only if the Adversary has not been defeated yet at the end of that round. You can play the Adversary card again (usual rules and cost).
Dialogue: Mulder: "If Modell makes it through surgery, I want to be the first person that he talks to."

name: Reporters At The Crime Scene
Text: Play when one player has just asked a Characteristic question and you were not the Directed player. If the player achieved the prerequisite skill number exactly, then he must tell all opponents the answer to the Characteristic question.

name: Reporters At The Crime Scene
Text: Play when one player has just asked a Characteristic question and you were not the Directed player. If the player achieved the prerequisite skill number exactly, then he must tell all opponents the answer to the Characteristic question.

name: Reproduction Movie Props
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's COMPUTER and SUBTERFUGE skills.
Dialogue: Mulder: "I'll bite, boys. What's with the toy guns?"MIB Rei: "To help us blend in."MIB Ray: "There's a cosplay convention in town. Pretty smart, huh?"MIB Rei: "It was my idea."

name: Resist or Serve
Text: Force an opponent Team investigating a Site to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check or the current player's turn ends immediately.
Dialogue: "Talk to me, Scully! Sculllllllyyyyy! Dammit! Scully! Scully! Scully! Scully!" - Mulder

name: Restricted Access Notice
Text: Play this card to force an opponent Team currently investigating a Site to make an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check. If they fail only Agents with the Keyword FBI may contribute their skills to any skill check made on this Site.
Dialogue: "As of an hour ago, they pumped concrete into the cave. Sealed it for precautionary reasons." - Mulder

name: Revitalizing Rest
Text: During the Briefing Phase, place one token on one Agent you control that normally starts with at least one token. This token is usable in the same way that starting tokens can be used. Remove this card from play.
Dialogue: "Mulder: I thought you said you were on vacation. Scully: "I am. I'm up in Maine."

name: Rigged Lottery
Text: Play this card to examine your opponent's hand and force that player to discard X cards (your choice).
Dialogue: "They're all the same! This game is fixed." - Glen Chao

name: Roach Completes The Link
Text: Play this card after a Combat has been initiated. Search through your Bureau Deck and add any two Combat cards to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau deck.
Dialogue: Scully: "Then why would he need Quinton Freely?"Mulder: "Maybe he needs a psychic connection to a place, a thing or an object.. a letter…that's why Quinton called himself The Mailman."

name: Roach Experiments in Your Neighborhood
Text: Play this card to give any one Agent SCIENCES skill equal to their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill level for the rest of this turn.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Why all the secrecy about your research? You've got some of the good townspeople suspicious."Dr Berenbaum: "You expect us to advertise that we've intentionally infested a house in their neighborhood with thousands of cockroaches?"

name: Road Hazard
Text: Negate one card with the Keyword MOVE.

name: Road Hazard
Text: Negate one card with the Keyword MOVE.

name: Road Map
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in the Field. Discard this card to return a Site card already investigated to your hand instead of discarding it.
Dialogue: Skinner: "What is it?"Scully: "Santa Claus."Mulder: "What?"Scully: "Stop. Turn around."

name: Road Trip
Text: Play on a Team in the Field during the Deployment Phase. If the Team makes a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 6+ skill check they may investigate two Sites this turn. Resolve each Site individually.

name: Road Trip
Text: Play on a Team in the Field during the Deployment Phase. If the Team makes a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 6+ skill check they may investigate two Sites this turn. Resolve each Site individually.

name: Rob Roberts, the Voracious Predator
Text: At the beginning of each Combat round you may choose one Agent and reduce that Agent's HEALTH by 2. If the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0 by the end of that round, Rob Roberts also heals 2 points of HEALTH during that round.
Dialogue: "What look like tool marks to you look to me like something more organic. Like it was made by a... a tongue or a proboscis." - Scully

name: Roche Takes a Hostage
Text: Force an opponent Team to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they fail, apply a -2 modifier to the Site skill check and negate all prior Witnesses that are modifying the Team's skill check.
Dialogue: "You're not giving me very much choice. I really don't want to go back to prison." - John Lee Roche

name: Roky Crikenson
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: Mulder: "What did you see that night?"Roky Crikenson: "This. It's all here. Immediately after seeing what I saw that night, I rushed right home and wrote it all down…48 hours straight. I didn't want to forget one detail."

name: Ronnie Strickland
Text: Only Agents with the Keyword BELIEVER may cause damage to Ronnie Strickland. If at any time during the Combat the Team attacked by Ronnie Strickland contains no Agents with the Keyword BELIEVER,the Combat ends immediately.
Dialogue: "Oh, man! What'd you have to go and do that for? You are in big trouble." - Ronnie Strickland

name: Roswell Cover Up
Text: Play this card during the Briefing phase. Force the Active player to remove one [RP] card already in play with the Keyword SITE, EQUIPMENT or RESOURCE from their side of the game (their choice). Then, search your opponent Discard Pile and remove one card of your choice from the game.
Dialogue: "Damn thing could be dangerous." - Man in black

name: Route 320-A, Craiger, Maryland
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "This place isn't even on the map. How'd you get here?" - Skinner

name: Run For It!
Text: Play this card on any Agent to immediately end combat for that Agent. Finish the combat without the Agent. The Agent takes no damage from the combat and may still contribute his skills to other skill checks.

name: Run For It!

name: Russian Horsemen
Text: If an Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero by this Adversary, place the Agent in a section of the table designated The Gulag and discard any Equipment. The Agent remains imprisoned for three full turns or until a Keyword ESCAPE card is played on them. Place three tokens on the Agent and remove one during each of the Agent's Briefing Phases. When the last token is removed, move the Agent to the Bureau (undamaged).
Dialogue: "Run!" - Mulder

name: S.W.A.T. Tactical Gear
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's LRC and CRC skills. Additionally, place 3 tokens on this card. Remove a token to prevent one point of damage. Discard the Tactical Gear when all tokens have been removed. Excess damage is applied to the Agent as normal. This card cannot be sold for [CP].
Dialogue: "Federal agent! I'm armed! Exit the vehicle, now!" - Mulder

name: S.W.A.T. Training
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: LRC, CRC or the ability to use MARTIAL ARTS Combat cards. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: S.W.A.T. Training
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: LRC, CRC or the ability to use MARTIAL ARTS Combat cards. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: SAC Darius Michaud
Game Effect: Any time during the Game you can sacrifice SAC Darius Michaud. Remove the card from the Game. If so, you may ask any one Characteristic question regarding one opponent's X-File.
Bio: Special Agent in Charge Darius Michaud played a significant role in the investigation of the mysterious bombing of a Federal Building in Dallas, Texas. He sacrificed himself in the building while searching for the bomb, demonstrating his dedication to duty and the safety of others.

name: SAC Fossa
Game Effect: Treat SAC Fossa as a RES 2 if she is in the Bureau. If Fossa is in the same Team as Agent Mosley Drummy and/or ASAC Dakota Whitney, she gains +1 to her COMPUTER and SCIENCES skills.
Bio: Special Agent in Charge Fossa was a senior member of the FBI. She was part of an FBI team that consecutively searched for missing Agent Monica Bannan and then Cheryl Cunningham.

name: Sacrificing a Pawn
Text: Play this card and discard any one Adversary card from your hand. You may add any one Keyword to one opponent's Site.
Dialogue: Scully: "Are you Luis Cardinal? Are you the man who shot my sister?"Luis Cardinal: "Don't kill me, please."Scully: "You shot my sister."Cardinal: "Please, I can tell you…"Scully: "Tell me!"Cardinal: "I can tell you what you want… you want… Krycek."

name: Sacrificing Blast
Text: Place this card on any opponent's Field with two tokens on it. Each time this opponent plays a [RP] card, they must discard one card from their hand (opponent's choice). Remove a token during your opponent's Briefing Phase. When all tokens have been removed, discard this card.
Dialogue: Scully: "Mulder, get in the car, there's no time!"

name: Safe House
Text: Play on any Witness with a skill modifier to permanently add the Keywords EVENT and RESOURCE to the Witness. Thus, the Witness acts as an EVENT, RESOURCE card and remains in play. Place this card below the Witness to remind you of the effect.

name: Safe House
Text: Play on any Witness with a skill modifier to permanently add the Keywords EVENT and RESOURCE to the Witness. Thus, the Witness acts as an EVENT, RESOURCE card and remains in play. Place this card below the Witness to remind you of the effect.

name: Sahale - Coastal Northwest Werewolf
Text: This card may be played at a Site where another Coastal Northwest Werewolf has been played, ignoring Activator requirements. The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.
Dialogue: "Be careful, these things travel in packs. If you see one, it's likely there are more stalking us, ready to pounce." - David Pease

name: Saint Elias Mountains, Yukon Territory, Canada
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "The area where it was found is in the terminal moraine of a glacier that has since receded. 200 years ago, the area where he was frozen was within the tree line, so there would have been a thaw." - Dr. Arlinsky

name: Saint Elizabeth Hospital, Washington, D.C.
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "The government. Augustus worked for them. I couldn't trust anyone. Especially the police. I was so scared. I was going too fast." - Mrs. Goldman

name: Samantha Mulder
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE skill check once per turn. You may have any number of Samantha Mulder cards in play.

name: Samantha Mulder
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE skill check once per turn. You may have any number of Samantha Mulder cards in play.

name: Samantha's Diary
Text: Discard Samantha's Diary to return one card from your hand to the Bureau deck, then shuffle the deck. At the beginning of your next Briefing Phase, you may draw two additional cards.
Dialogue: Scully: "It's a diary. It's your sister's."

name: Samantha, Agrarian Clone
Text: Adds 1 [RP] to your Pool each time a Keyword ALIEN or ALIEN INVESTIGATION card is played.
Dialogue: Jeremiah Smith: "She's a drone, Mister Mulder. A worker."Mulder: "What are you talking about?

name: Sammon Roque
Text: Adds 2 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or adds 1 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check.

name: Samuel Aboah
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. One opposing Agent (your choice) is considered paralyzed and may not move or contribute to the Combat. The target Agent is still vulnerable to Aboah's attack. This Adversary may use SUBTERFUGE cards.
Dialogue: Scully: "He can't have gotten far."Mulder: "This guy can squeeze into a coffee can, Scully. He could be anywhere."

name: Samuel Hartley
Text: Play on a Team in the Field that has just had an Agent removed from the game this turn. Make an OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check of 4+. If successful, the Agent remains in play.

name: Samuel Hartley
Text: Play on a Team in the Field that has just had an Agent removed from the game this turn. Make an OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check of 4+. If successful, the Agent remains in play.

name: San Diego County Hospital, CA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: Scully: "Do you think I don't want what's best for this child? Do you think that I'm not trying to save her life?"

name: Sangradura, Mexico
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION, one MOTIVE, or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Hey, guard! Come here! Andale! Hey, guard! Somebody come here!" - Doggett

name: Santa Monica Peer, Los Angeles, CA
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE, one METHOD or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Bosco's passes with the cups and balls. Wah-day… Chubio… Colerader. Three gone… And yet, three return." - Maleeni

name: Satellite Navigator
Text: Place 2 tokens on this card. Discard a token to look through your Bureau deck to draw any Site that asks a MOTIVE or METHOD question. Add it to your hand and reshuffle your Bureau deck. When no tokens remain, move this card to the Discard Pile.
Dialogue: Mulder: "I'm going to get you out of there."

name: Satellite Photos
Text: Adds two to the Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill.

name: Schlugg's Cult
Text: Attach this card to any Agent in a Team. Place five tokens on this card (three if the Team has any Agent with MEDICAL skill). The Agent must remain in the Field and cannot contribute to any Skill check until all tokens have been removed. Remove one token during each Active player's Debriefing Phase. Discard this card when the last token is removed. The Agent remains in the Field. Schlugg's Cult does not initiate Combat.
Dialogue: "No! Ahhh!!! You son of a bitch!" - Scully

name: Scott Garrett
Text: This Adversary can attack one Agent (your choice) and is then discarded. If Agent Pendrell is in the Investigating Team, then he takes the LRC damage instead of the selected Agent. Agents attacked by this Adversary must immediately discard all attached Keyword ALIEN Equipment.
Dialogue: "A man, if he's any man at all, knows he must be ready to sacrifice himself to that which is greater than he." - Scott Garrett

name: Scott Ostelhoff
Text: This card is free if the Site prerequisite is ALIEN INVESTIGATION. Any Witnesses contributing to the Site skill check are immediately discarded. This Adversary may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards.
Dialogue: Scott Ostelhoff: "Is he a believer?"Babcock: "Oh, yeah."Ostelhoff: "Then we're the only ones who know."

name: Scripted Fate
Text: Write down the question you think your opponent will ask if successfully investigates this Site. Place this card on your opponent's Field with the paper underneath. If your opponent asks that question, you are not forced to answer it. Otherwise, add 2 [CP] to your [CP] pool. Discard this card afterwards.
Dialogue: Scully: "How is it you think you know me so well, Mr. Padgett?" Phillip Padgett: "I'm writing about you."

name: Scuba Suit
Text: Once per turn, the Scuba Suit adds 2 to the Agent's OBSERVATION or SUBTERFUGE skills during any skill check on any Site card related to a coastal state or country, or mentioning the words: 'Lake', 'River' or 'Sea'.
Dialogue: Mulder: "Once, I, uh... I got a quarter off of the deep end at the "Y" pool."

name: Scully's Cancer
Text: Play this card to force Agent Dana Scully's Team to make a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check. If they fail, move Scully to the Hospital immediately with zero HEALTH. Scully's recovery rate will be 1 damage token per turn. Attach this card to Scully as a reminder until she is fully healed. You can negate this card by using the Alien Pathogen Treatment card.
Dialogue: "… matching the DNA from this virus with that which I believe has caused my cancer." - Scully

name: Scully's Dream
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "To fit in with her brothers, Dana also shot a snake." - Margaret Scully

name: Scully's Dream, Georgetown, MD
Question: You may ask one Method question.
Dialogue: "To fit in with her brothers, Dana also shot at the snake." - Margaret Scully

name: Sea Off Tildeskan, Norway
Question: You may ask one RESULT question.

name: Sea Off Tildeskan, Norway
Question: You may ask one RESULT question.

name: Seamus the Cat
Text: Play this card to gently push two cards off the top of your opponent's Bureau deck. The two cards are discarded.
Dialogue: Mulder: "What do you think, Scully? Should we ask him what he knows about the missing Knuffle Bunny?"Scully: "I think we've dealt with enough cats, Mulder."

name: Search Warrant
Text: Play this card to examine your opponent's hand. Your opponent must discard two cards from their hand (your choice).
Dialogue: "Elaine Tanner? We have a warrant to search the premises." - Scully

name: Second Chance Memories
Text: Play this card during the Investigation Phase. If a Team of Agents you control fails the Site prerequisite skill check, you may recover up to two cards played on that Site from your Discard Pile (your choice), including Combat cards, but you cannot play them again this turn.
Dialogue: "The Smoking Man's dead." - Skinner

name: Secret Government Files
Text: Discard this card to add three to the Agent's BUREAUCRACY skill.

name: Secret of the Horned Beast
Text: Subtract 4 from one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or BEHAVIORAL skill check.
Dialogue: Detective White: "What is that?"Scully: "What's what?"White: "That pattern, there, on his chest."Mulder: "Yeah, I see it. It looks like a… goat, some kinda horned beast."

name: Secret Passage
Text: Discard this card to add three to the Agent's SUBTERFUGE skill.

name: Secret Protection
Text: Play this card during the Investigation phase (before any Combat has taken place) to search your Bureau Deck for any one card with the keyword COMBAT. Add the card to your hand and reveal it to your opponent. Shuffle your Bureau deck. If the card is playable this turn, you can do it for zero cost.
Dialogue: "You're free to go, of course. The choice is still yours." - The Cigarette-Smoking Man

name: Secret Railroad
Text: Play this card to give any one Agent BUREAUCRACY skill level equal to their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill level for the rest of this turn.
Dialogue: Scully: "I'm standing in a train car just like the one in your alien autopsy video. Only I realise that I've been here before."Mulder: "What are you talking about, Scully?"Scully: "This is where they brought me, Mulder. This is where they put the implant in my neck. In one of these cars."

name: Secrets of the Navajo People
Text: Play this card to give any one Agent MEDICAL skill equal to their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill level for the rest of this turn.
Dialogue: "I watched my father perform the chants as a young boy and saw their healing magic." -  Albert Hosteen

name: Sect Leader Anthony Tipet
Text: You may play this card in its normal way, or use it to immediately end combat and control one Agent (your choice). Move the Agent to any section of the table. The Agent must remain in that section. Attach this card to the chosen Agent as a reminder. Discard this card during your opponent's next Investigation phase.
Dialogue: "If we have the courage to see into darkness we see into God... free of the clay which confines us." - Anthony Tipet

name: Section Chief Joseph Mcgrath
Text: Force one Agent (your choice) back to the Bureau immediately. The Agent may not contribute to any skill checks this turn.

name: Section Chief Scott Blevins
Game Effect: Treat Section Chief Blevins as a RES 2 if he is in the Bureau Section. If he is in the Bureau Section, he may contribute to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resources Pool during the Briefing Phase.

name: Section Chief Scott Blevins
Game Effect: Treat Section Chief Blevins as a RES 2 if he is in the Bureau Section. If he is in the Bureau Section, he may contribute to the Conspiracy Pool instead of the Resources Pool during the Briefing Phase.

name: Section Chief Scott Blevins Assassinated
Text: If your opponent uses Agent Blevins as RES 2, while being in the Bureau during the Briefing Phase, Agent Blevins is instantly killed and removed from the game.
Dialogue: "Blevins had been on payroll for four years to a biotechnology company called Roush, which is somehow connected to all this." - Skinner

name: Security Breach
Text: Subtract 4 from one Team's SUBTERFUGE or OBSERVATION skill check.
Dialogue: "I reviewed the building security tapes. Modell can be seen entering and leaving unnoticed. He had the word "pass" on his lapel. Guards who waved him by don't remember seeing him at all." -  Mulder

name: Security Clearance
Text: Negate any one Keyword SUBTERFUGE card.

name: Security Override
Text: Force an opponent Team investigating a Site to make a COMPUTER 4+ skill check or the current player's turn ends immediately.
Dialogue: "The cow jumped over the moon." - Mr. C

name: Security Pass
Text: Discard this card to change the Site Prerequisite to ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY in a Site investigated by the Agent equipped with this card. Keywords of the Site card are also changed
Dialogue: Security Guard: "Proceed down the hallway, please."

name: Semi-Jacketed Hollow Points

Dialogue: Mulder: "Children born with vestigial tails don't interest you?"Scully: "Caudal appendages. Fetuses have them. Their coccyx enlargens to contain the spinal fluid and then it shrinks as the child develops. Occasionally, it doesn't."

name: Tad O'Malley'
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY skill check.
Dialogue: "A government that taps your phone, collects your data and monitors your whereabouts with impunity. A government preparing to use that data against you when it strikes, and the final takeover begins." - Tad O'Malley

name: Tahoma - Coastal Northwest Werewolf
Text: This card may be played at a Site where another Coastal Northwest Werewolf has been played, ignoring Activator requirements. The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.
Dialogue: "Be careful, these things travel in packs. If you see one, it's likely there are more stalking us, ready to pounce." - David Pease

name: Take Cover!
Text: Play this card on any combatant to decrease damage from one LONG RANGE COMBAT source by two points this round.

name: Take Cover!
Text: Play this card on any combatant to decrease damage from one LONG RANGE COMBAT source by two points this round.

name: Taking Chances
Text: Play this card to search through your Bureau Deck and add any one Adversary card to your hand. Show your opponent which card you have added. Shuffle your deck.

name: Tandem Investigations
Text: Play this card when Agent Bill Patterson is about to use his Game Effect and only if Agent Nemhauser is in his same Team. Patterson's LRC and CRC skills are doubled during the Combat. Any opponents sent to the Hospital as a result of Patterson's LRC damage do not cause him any damage that round.
Dialogue: "He bit me! The son of a bitch bit me like a dog!" - Nemhauser

name: Tape Recorder
Text: Adds two to the Agent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill.

name: Taped Intelligence
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's BUREAUCRACY skill. GOVERNMENT Adversaries may now attack the Agent's Team when investigating a Site, even when they would otherwise be barred from doing so.

name: Taped Intelligence
Text: Adds 2 to the Agent's BUREAUCRACY skill. GOVERNMENT Adversaries may now attack the Agent's Team when investigating a Site, even when they would otherwise be barred from doing so.

name: Teamwork
Text: Play this card on any Team consisting of no more than two Agents during the Investigation Phase when they are sent to investigate a Site. You may add a number of tokens to the [RP] pool equal to the Agents' total RES value.

name: Telemedicine Tools
Text: Place this Equipment card in your Hospital section. During your Healing phase, you may place one Keyword MEDICAL or SCIENCES ACTIVE card under this card, face down. During your Investigation phase, you may play one of these cards for 2 [RP] less. No more than 2 cards may be under this card.
Dialogue: Doggett: "Help me out here, Agent Scully."

name: Temple of the Seven Stars, Apison, TN
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: "Ephesian had six women on the verge of suicide. You witnessed it. My concern is if the temple members are released, any subsequent federal investigation will ignite Ephesian's paranoia to such a degree that we won't have another Waco on our hands... we'll have Jonestown." - Skinner

name: Tempus Fugit
Text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase to force any opponent to skip the next Healing, Requisition and Deployment phases and go directly to the Case Assignment phase. Remove this card from the game. The effects of this card may not be negated.
Created By: Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel, Greg Fremaux
Dialogue: Mike Millar: "You're saying the man sitting in seat thirteen-F was abducted mid-flight without any depressurization of the cabin, without any effect on the plane…"

name: Terminal Damage
Text: Play on any Agent that has taken 5 or more damage from a single damage source. That Agent must go to the Hospital immediately and may no longer participate in the combat. The Agent cannot leave the Hospital until fully healed. Subtract 5 from the Agent's Cost. If the Cost is zero or less, the Agent is removed from the game. (Agents Lamana, Willis, Purdue and Weiss are immune to this effect.)

name: Terminal Damage
Text: Play on any Agent that has taken 5 or more damage from a single damage source. That Agent must go to the Hospital immediately and may no longer participate in the combat. The Agent cannot leave the Hospital until fully healed. Subtract 5 from the Agent's Cost. If the Cost is zero or less, the Agent is removed from the game. (Agents Lamana, Willis, Purdue and Weiss are immune to this effect.)

name: Terri Roberts
Text: This card may be played on a Site at which the "Margi Kleinjan" Adversary card has been played, ignoring Activator requirements. When this occurs, both Adversaries attack simultaneously (treat as one combat) and double both cards' LRC, CRC, and HEALTH. Triple both cards' LRC, CRC and HEALTH if the Agents are using OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill.

name: Teso dos Bichos Excavation, Ecquadorian Highlands, South America
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.

name: The African Artifact
Text: Attach this card to an Agent with cost higher than three. Once you had successfully investigated a Site, you may remove this card and the Agent from play to ask an extra characteristic question regarding one opponent's X-File.
Dialogue: "A genuine artifact, one of several pieces of an unknown whole…" - Mulder

name: The Band-Aid Nose Man
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. This Adversary can only attack Teams that consist of a single Agent, including Teams that originally had more Agents but were reduced to one after a Combat.
Dialogue: "And did you smell it? It smells like nothing on this Earth." - The Trashman

name: The Bat Thing
Text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. This card may be played in its normal way or on any Team that includes at least one Agent with the keyword SKEPTIC, ignoring Activator requirements. The Bat Thing may use SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.
Dialogue: "Today, he might have been fine but this thing hunts like a bat. It only attacks at night." - Ernie Stefaniuk

name: The Black Ace
Text: Play 3 [CP] to move up to 4 [RP] from your opponent's [RP] pool to your [CP] pool immediately.
Dialogue: "Did you ever see anything like this? This is what I want." - Mr. C

name: The Calusari
Text: Negates one OCCULT CREATURE.

name: The Calusari
Text: Negates one OCCULT CREATURE.

name: The Calusari
Text: Negates one Occult Creature.
Dialogue: "They are the Calusari. In Romania they are responsible for the correct observance of sacred rites." - Maggie Holvey

name: The Cigarette-Smoking Man
Dialogue: "You can kill me now, but you'll never know the truth. And that's why I'll win." - The Cigarette Smoking Man

name: The Cigarette-Smoking Man Strikes
Text: Change any Keyword to any other Keyword on a card played by your opponent. This effect lasts until the end of the turn.

name: The Cigarette-Smoking Man Strikes
Text: Change any Keyword to any other Keyword on a card played by your opponent. This effect lasts until the end of the turn.

name: The Cigarette-Smoking Man's Solution
Text: Play on a Team of Agents in the Field after your opponent has identified your X-File's AFFILIATION. Your opponent must immediately move every Agent on the Team to the Hospital. Each Agent receives 4 damage (or maximum damage if their HEALTH is less than 4).
Dialogue: "You haven't got any tape. And you haven't got any deal. You can't play poker if you're not holding any cards Mr Skinner. You ever wondered what it would be like to die in a plane crash? Of botulism? Even a heart attack isn't that uncommon for a man of your age. You think I'm bluffing?" -  The Cigarette-Smoking Man

name: The Cigarette-Smoking Man's Warning
Text: Play after your opponent has identified your X-File's METHOD. While this card is in play, you (as the Directed Player) may play Keyword GOVERNMENT cards for free and your GOVERNMENT Adversaries may ignore activator requirements.
Dialogue: "As a friend, I should advise you, Mr. Skinner, that withholding information on matters of national security is punishable under the laws of this country for treason and sedition." - The Cigarette - Smoking Man

name: The Conundrum
Text: Play to negate one Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION card.

name: The Conundrum
Text: Play to negate one Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION card.

name: The Dark Angel
Text: The Dark Angel can play all combat cards for one [CP] less.

name: The Death Card
Text: Play to add 4 [CP] to your pool immediately.
Dialogue: "There is suspicion of an accomplice, based on the one piece of evidence found at the crime scene, a so - called "death card" used by soldiers in Vietnam to mark their kills…" - Assistant Director Walter Skinner

name: The Devil's Choice
Text: Discard the top card from both players' Bureau decks. If your card has higher cost than your opponent's, you may add 8 tokens to your [RP] pool (if you are the active player) or to the [CP] pool (if you are the Directed player). If lower, only empty your [RP] and [CP] pools, your opponent's pools remain unaffected.
Dialogue: "Is this what you saw? It's a Seraphim. An angel, with four faces. Those of a man, a lion, an eagle, and a bull." - Father McCue

name: The Dutchman's, MT
Game Effect: If you successfully investigate this Site, you may force an opponent to discard one card from the top of their Bureau Deck.
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "I'm not gonna talk about Judy." - Agent Phillip Jeffries

name: The Elder's Call
Text: Put two tokens on this card. You can use a token to keep at your side a non-resource Witness card or a Site for an additional turn. Remove a token each time you use this ability. You can use both in the same turn. Remove this card from the game once all the tokens have been removed.
Dialogue: "Mister Mulder, I have someone here who'd like to speak with you." - First Elder

name: The End
Text: Play this card after answering "no" to a Characteristic Question regarding your X-File. Your opponent cannot ask about the same Characteristic for the next X turns, up to a maximum of three. X = [CP] cost paid.
Dialogue: "We entrusted you. You failed." - Well-Manicured Man

name: The Erlenmeyer Flask
Text: Negates any one card played against your Team during a BUREAUCRACY or ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: The Evil One
Text: This card does not initiate combat. Play this card in conjunction with any other Adversary that initiates combat. The Adversary's LRC, CRC, and HEALTH are doubled.

name: The Evil Within
Text: You may play Keyword BLUFF cards for 1 [CP] less. If placed face down under a Site (as usual), the cost is reduced by 1 more [CP] for a total of 2 [CP] less. A Bluff could be played this way for free, but you can never gain tokens by playing a Bluff card. Your opponent may pay 6 [RP] to force you to discard this card.
Dialogue: "It's a goddamn bad story, isn't it, Hawk?." - Sarah Palmer

name: The Experiment
Text: The Experiment engages two opposing Agents (your choice) in Combat.
Dialogue: "I'm supposed to watch the box and see if anything appears inside." - Sam Colby

name: The Falls at Arcadia, San Diego County, CA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "So is this the American dream? This place?" - Scully

name: The Goal In Sight Again
Text: Play this card after one of your Teams successfully investigates a Site with OBSERVATION skill as a prerequisite. Place this card in your Bureau. Discard this Resource to add 1 to an OBSERVATION skill check.
Dialogue: "At times, I almost dream. I, too, have spent a life the sages' way and tread once more familiar paths." - Mulder, quoting "Paracelsus" by Robert Browning

name: The Golem Exacts Revenge
Text: The Golem is unaffected by Combat attacks. This Adversary will attack for two CLOSE RANGE COMBAT rounds and is then discarded.
Dialogue: Mulder: "So the Golem is an imperfect creation."Kenneth Ungar: "Kind of a monster, really. Unable to speak or feel anything but the most primitive of emotions. It runs amok. It has to be destroyed by its creator."

name: The Great Mutato
Text: Play this card during the Case Assignment phase and place it in the Field. Discard this card to negate one ADVERSARY card played by your opponent this turn (or discard it in any case at the end of the Debriefing Phase).
Dialogue: "The experiments he attempted were too advanced for his understanding. The results of his experiments – unsatisfactory." - The Great Mutato

name: The Grey-Haired Man
Text: Any Witness RESOURCE cards in play are immediately discarded. The Grey-Haired Man may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards. Damage caused by this Adversary during LONG RANGE COMBAT may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).
Dialogue: Frohike: "The doors work on redundant systems. We're working fast."Mulder: "Work faster!"

name: The Grey-Haired Man
Text: Reduce each Agent's LRC to 1. If target Team has more than one Agent, Your opponent may select one of those Agents not to participate in the Combat. If no Agent is chosen, then an additional LRC round will be played until your opponent selects an Agent to skip the Combat.
Created By: Greg Fremaux, Alfredo Sánchez, Robert Czepiel
Dialogue: "I've suffered some very personal... losses recently, and... I was... I was hoping…" - Mulder

name: The Host Attacks
Text: Place five tokens on any Agent that loses HEALTH as a result of this creature's attack. Remove a token in each of that Agent's Briefing Phases. At the end of the turn in which the last token is removed, the Agent is removed from the game. This card can be negated by the Team containing the afflicted Agent making a MEDICAL 3+ skill check or by playing a HEALING card on the afflicted player prior to the Agent being removed.

name: The Host Attacks
Text: Place five tokens on any Agent that loses HEALTH as a result of this creature's attack. Remove a token in each of that Agent's Briefing Phases. At the end of the turn in which the last token is removed, the Agent is removed from the game. This card can be negated by the Team containing the afflicted Agent making a MEDICAL 3+ skill check or by playing a HEALING card on the afflicted player prior to the Agent being removed.

name: The Jupiter-Saturn Conjunction
Episode: The Path to the Black Lodge
Text: Force an opponent Team investigating a Site to make a OCCULT INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check or the current player's turn ends immediately.
Dialogue: "When Jupiter and Saturn meet, Oh, what a crop of mummy wheat." - Windom Earle

name: The List
Text: List one Agent from the Investigating Team on a piece of paper. Place this card in your opponent's Field with the paper underneath. If the Agent listed Investigates a different Site before this card is negated, reveal the paper with the listed Agent. The Agent must go to the Hospital with zero HEALTH and may not contribute to skill checks this turn. Discard this card.

name: The Local Law Enforcement Are Uncooperative
Text: Negate one Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card.

name: The Local Law Enforcement Are Uncooperative
Text: Negate one Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card.

name: The Log Knows
Text: Play this card next to your X-File with three tokens on it. Discard a token to apply a +1 modifier to any one Agent's Skill check. You may do this once per turn.
Dialogue: "Come on then. My log does not judge." - Log Lady

name: The Lone Gunman
Text: Play this card to search through your Bureau Deck and draw one Keyword ACTIVE card that increases an Agent or Team skill check during the Investigation phase. Add the card to your hand and reveal it to your opponent. Shuffle your deck.
Dialogue: "And began publishing a… what shall I call it… rag, called "The Lone Gunman."" - Morris

name: The Lone Gunmen
Text: Play "The Lone Gunmen" card on a Site. While played on a Site, The Lone Gunmen are considered a Keyword WITNESS card. A Site with The Lone Gunmen played on it stays in the Field until they are removed. During your Briefing Phase, pay 1 RP to place a token on the Site. When a Team investigates the Site, each token adds 1 to the skill check. Discard The Lone Gunmen after the skill check is resolved.

name: The Mad Hatter
Text: Play this card on a Team in the Field that plays a Witness. The Mad Hatter abducts the Witness and the Team must make a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check. If unsuccessful, the Site skill check is failed and the Witness is removed from the game. If the Team makes the skill check, this card is negated and removed from the game.
Dialogue: "You bring my hearts and give them back to me…I'll tell you everything you want to know." - John Lee Roche

name: The Mailman
Text: Play this card to allow you to move one game effect token from any one card to another immediately. This may not take a card above the normal number of tokens allowed.

name: The Man From Another Place
Text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase. Discard a Keyword CONSPIRACY card from your hand with a cost of 7 [CP] or less to gain a number of [RP] tokens equal to that card's cost.
Dialogue: "When you see me again it won't be me." - The Arm

name: The Man in the Mirror
Text: Play this card on an Agent controlled by the Active Player during a Site skill check. Until end of turn, that Agent cannot use their base skills for the check. Instead, use the base skills of any one of your Agents (your choice). If none of your Agents have that skill, the skill value is zero.
Dialogue: "How's Annie? How's Annie? How's Annie?" - Mr. C

name: The Mandela Effect
Episode: The Lost Art of Forehead Sweat
Text: When a team of Agents contributes to a single skill check this turn, they use the following swapped skills: ALIEN INVESTIGATION ↔ BUREAUCRACY, BEHAVIORAL ↔ OCCULT INVESTIGATION, COMPUTER ↔ SCIENCES, OBSERVATION ↔ MEDICAL. If a skill is missing, its value is 0. Remove this card from play.
Dialogue: "No, it's called the Mengele Effect." - Reggie Something

name: The Manitou
Dialogue: "The Manitou is an evil spirit capable of changing a man into a beast." - Sioux Tribal Elder

name: The Manitou Stalks His Prey
Text: Any Agent wounded by the Manitou may not heal wounds until a Healing card is successfully played on him.

name: The Manitou Stalks His Prey
Text: Any Agent wounded by the Manitou may not heal wounds until a Healing card is successfully played on him.

name: The Mechanic
Text: The Mechanic may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: The Mechanic
Text: The Mechanic may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: The Mechanic
Text: The Mechanic may use Martial Arts and Subterfuge Combat cards.
Dialogue: Mulder: "There were three men last night, I was chased!" Deep Throat: "If you were chased you would have been killed. Those men are trained for that sort of business, and they are trained very well."

name: The Mulder Family Legacy
Text: Play this card on a Team with Fox Mulder to search through your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: "Bill Mulder", "Mrs. Mulder", "Samantha Mulder", or "Samantha, Agrarian Clone". If you play the chosen card immediately, then you may do so for half cost (rounded up).
Dialogue: Bill Mulder: "My one - year old just said his first word."Young Cigarette - Smoking Man: "What was the word?"Bill Mulder: "J.F.K."

name: The Niemans
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's OBSERVATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check, or play this card to negate the Bluff "You've Got a Tail".
Dialogue: Fred Nieman: "Is it okay for us to get into our bathroom now?"Mulder: "Excuse me, sir?"Nieman: "Well, I was hoping we could get into our bathroom sometime this evening. You said the police were going to come by and dust it for some fingerprints but that was over four hours ago."

name: The Overcoat Man
Text: Basic Game Only: Apply a -2 modifier to any one skill check involving one of the following skills: MEDICAL, OBSERVATION, BEHAVIORAL.Advanced Game: Pay the listed [CP] Cost, where X = the number of [CP] paid to gain the desired modifier to one of the following skills: MEDICAL, OBSERVATION, BEHAVIORAL. (1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: The Overcoat Man
Text: Basic Game Only: Apply a -2 modifier to any one skill check involving one of the following skills: MEDICAL, OBSERVATION, BEHAVIORAL.Advanced Game: Pay the listed [CP] Cost, where X = the number of [CP] paid to gain the desired modifier to one of the following skills: MEDICAL, OBSERVATION, BEHAVIORAL. (1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: The Overcoat Woman
Text: Force your opponent to reveal their hand. Select one [CP] card. You may either play the selected card immediately (at its normal cost) or send it directly to its owner's Discard Pile. If played, the card is discarded afterwards.
Dialogue: "Yes, he is safe. We're here." - The Overcoat Woman

name: The Peacock Brothers
Text: Apply -1 to any Equipment cards attached to the Team that modify LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. Damage caused by this Adversary may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).
Dialogue: "That farm belongs to the Peacock family. Three boys now - well, men. Guess you could call them human." - Sheriff Andy Taylor

name: The Plain-Clothes Man
Text: Play this card to reveal any face down card (except an X-File).
Dialogue: The Plain-Clothes Man: "You're wasting time. While you're chasing your partner, they're destroying the evidence."Mulder: "Who?"The Plain-Clothes Man: "Just follow the evidence. If you don't, by tomorrow the responsible parties will be out of your reach."

name: The Plan Must Be Carried Out
Text: Place this card next to your X-File. You may play [RP] Events for one [RP] less. You may only have one of this card in play.
Dialogue: "This is it, Jackrabbit's Palace!" - Bobby Briggs

name: The Psychotic Attack
Text: Damage from LONG RANGE COMBAT may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).

name: The Psychotic Attack
Text: Damage from LONG RANGE COMBAT may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).

name: The Right Hand's Toll
Text: Pay 2 [CP] to move up to 3 [RP] from your opponent's [RP] pool to your [CP] pool immediately.
Dialogue: "Name's Nathaniel Teager. 26 confirmed solo enemy kills. A veritable killing machine. Left for dead by the same government that created him." - Denny Markham

name: The Sandman
Text: The Creature has LONG RANGE COMBAT and CLOSE RANGE COMBAT equal to the highest Combat rating on the opposing team (including modifiers) +1. The Sandman may use SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: The Sandman
Text: The Creature has LONG RANGE COMBAT and CLOSE RANGE COMBAT equal to the highest Combat rating on the opposing team (including modifiers) +1. The Sandman may use SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: The Siddhi Mystic's Curse
Text: Draw a number of cards from your Bureau deck equal to the number of Agents on target team. Use the cost value of each drawn card to assign damage to any Agent in that team (your choice) as separated LRC attacks. Draw enough cards until you have numerical values to assign the damage. Shuffle the deck (including the drawn cards.
Dialogue: "The Siddhi are a very mysterious and particularly powerful order of Fakirs." - C. Burks

name: The Smoking Man Strikes!
Text: Change any Keyword to any other Keyword on a card played by your opponent. This effect lasts until the end of the turn.
Dialogue: "Nothing vanishes without a trace, burn it!" - Cigarette Smoking Man

name: The Stupendous Yappi
Text: Flip the top card of your Bureau Deck. Discard the revealed card. If the revealed card has the Keyword CONSPIRACY, subtract 1 from the skill check. If not, add 3 to one CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: The System is Watching
Text: Play this card to examine your opponent's hand. Select one Active card. If your opponent plays that card this turn, subtract 4 points from their Team's Site skill check.
Dialogue: "The AI would learn from humans. It was constructed to become progressively more intelligent."

name: The Thinker
Text: Change one Keyword to any other one Keyword on a card played by your opponent.

name: The Thinker
Text: Change one Keyword to any other one Keyword on a card played by your opponent.

name: The Toothpick Man
Text: Play this card to negate one Witness card played by your opponent. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck. Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: "He is not human." - Gibson Praise

name: The Truth
Text: Play this card after having successfully investigated a Site to ask an X-File's identity without incurring a penalty question. Remove this card from the game.
Dialogue: Byers: "Why risk perfect happiness, Mulder? Why risk your lives?"Mulder: "Because I need to know the truth."Byers: "You already know the truth."

name: The Twins Poisonous Attack
Text: This card does not initiate combat. The Team must make an OBSERVATION 5+ skill check. If unsuccessful, choose one Agent in the Team. That Agent receives 4 points of damage but can still contribute with his skills if HEALTH rating has not been reduced to 0. Healing cards can be played to avoid the damage.
Dialogue: "We didn't drink enough to make us sick." - Scully

name: The Ultimate Secret
Text: Play this card to look at the top six cards of your opponent's Bureau deck. Choose and discard three of them, then return the rest to the top of their deck in any order.
Dialogue: "Do you know what the ultimate secret is? Do you want to know... what Laura did?" - Harold Smith

name: The Vampire, A.K.A. The Unholy Spirit
The Vampire, A.K.A. The Unholy Spirit
The Video Trap
Text: Place this card next to your X-File. You may draw one card for free in each of your opponents' Briefing Phases.

name: The Walk
Text: Subtract one from all damage sources applied to this Adversary.

name: The Walk
Text: Subtract one from all damage sources applied to this Adversary.
Dialogue: "I know a lot of crips have the same dream. The Walk. In my dream, I rise up, out of my chair, and I can stand. I look down the hallway, I'm not in the ward anymore, I'm home. With my baby girl." - Amputee

name: The Well-Manicured Man's Vendetta
Text: Attach this card to a Witness RESOURCE. If at any time the Witness is negated or removed from the game, your opponent loses 5 [CP] and must discard all GOVERNMENT Adversaries in their deck.
Dialogue: The Well - Manicured Man: "This was a professional hit."The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "Were you sleeping with her? Surely you wouldn't be so foolish as to put the project at risk for the sake of your personal pleasures."The Well - Manicured Man: "Find her killer!"

name: The Woodsmen, Sentinels of the Black Lodge
Text: At the beginning of each combat round you may discard 2 [CP] from your [CP] pool to heal 1 point of damage to the Woodsmen. The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.
Dialogue: "Got a Light?" - Woodman

name: There's a Bomb on the Train
Text: Play this card to change the question(s) listed on one Site card to AFFILIATION.
Dialogue: "This car is wired to an explosive device. It armed automatically when I entered the car." -  The Red-Haired Man

name: They are Watching
Text: Play this card to force your opponent to play with an open hand (all cards face up) until end of turn. If a card forces your opponent to discard any card randomly from their hand, you may choose them directly.
Dialogue: "Dr. Sandoz, I don't know if this is a secure line." - Scully

name: Third Elder's Deliberation
Text: During the Briefing Phase, remove one Game Effect token on any Agent that normally starts with at least one token. You may only have one of this card in your Bureau deck. Remove this card from play.
Dialogue: "Protection against what?" - Third Elder

name: This Is Not Happening
Text: Force an opponent to discard three cards from his hand at random.

name: This Never Happened
Text: Play this card to force the investigating player to discard their entire hand.
Dialogue: "That's how heroes are made.!" - Carl Gerhard Busch

name: Thorough Documentation
Text: Play prior to a Site skill check. If the Site skill check is successful, place this card in your Bureau Section. You may discard this card in any of your investigation phases to add 2 to a Site skill check. Discard this card after you've used the modifier.

name: Thorough Documentation
Text: Play prior to a Site skill check. If the Site skill check is successful, place this card in your Bureau Section. You may discard this card in any of your investigation phases to add 2 to a Site skill check. Discard this card after you've used the modifier.

name: Thoughtographs
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill.
Dialogue: "That's a passport photo from a local drugstore. The druggist who took that photo is the last known person to have seen Mary LeFante. Only he claims that wasn't the photo he was taking." - Mulder

name: Three of a Kind
Text: You may use this card to place up to six cards under it (face down) at any time. These cards cannot contain the Activator CONSPIRACY. You can play cards from here as if they were in your hand, with their cost increased by 1. Discard all cards if this card is negated. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.
Dialogue: "You know, Byers, growing old with us ain't so bad." - Byers

name: Three Words, One Solution
Text: Play this card to discard all [CP] tokens from your opponent's pool. The first card with [CP] cost played by your opponent may be played for free this turn.
Dialogue: "The cavalry just arrived"- Frohike

name: Tim Decker
Text: Adds 1 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OBSERVATION skill check.
Dialogue: Tim Decker: "Agent Mulder…"Mulder: "Yeah?"Decker: "The police found something outside."Scully: "Mona Wustner?"Decker: "No, Sugar - her dog. He's dead."Mulder: "Finally a body."

name: Time Rush

Dialogue: "She was strangled. He used an eight-gauge electrical cord. He took something from the body post-mortem… a trophy. A piece of fabric cut from her clothes… in the shape of a heart." - Mulder

name: White Buffalo
Text: You may remove one game effect token or wound token from any cards under your control.

name: Whitman College, Walla Walla, WA
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one RESULT question.
Dialogue: Scully: "Last night, a faculty member was found dead in the stairwell under suspicious circumstances."Mulder: "Can we skip to the part where you explain why this is a FBI matter?"

name: Widespread Panic
Text: Subtract 3 from any one ALIEN INVESTIGATION, EVIDENCE COLLECTION, OBSERVATION or SCIENCES skill check.
Dialogue: "All right, listen up! I'm Agent Dana Scully from the Federal Bureau of Investigation. I am assuring you that you are not in any danger. Everything is going to be OK if you just calm down, and start acting rationally. Now where the hell are those road maps?" -  Scully

name: William
Text: Apply a +2 modifier to any skill check made by a Team of Agents in the Field during the Investigation phase.
Dialogue: "I am scared for you, Mulder. And for William. The forces against us are unrelenting." - Scully

name: William Hastings
Text: Adds 3 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.
Dialogue: "We gave him the numbers. And he started to float up... and he said some words. 'Cooper, Cooper.' Right before his head disappeared." - William Hastings

name: Windom Earle, Seeker of the Black Lodge
Text: If this Adversary's HEALTH is reduced to 0 during Combat, you may immediately play an Adversary card with a cost less than 5 from your discard pile, ignoring Activator requirements, at its normal cost. That Adversary immediately begins a normal Combat with the Team.
Dialogue: "If you give me your soul, I'll let Annie live." - Windom Earle

name: Wire-Tap
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's SUBTERFUGE skill.

name: Wire-Tap
Text: Adds 1 to the Agent's SUBTERFUGE skill.

name: Wire-Tap
Text: Adds +1 to the Agent's Subterfuge skill.
Dialogue: "I had enough on that surveillance to arrest those suspects after 3 days, I could have nailed them on 40 counts of bank fraud. But you left me there. I'm surprised you even noticed I was gone." - Mulder

name: Witch Hunter
Text: Search through your Bureau deck and play any one Witness card with the Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION at half cost (rounded up). If you successfully investigate a Site with this Witness this turn, you may search for an Equipment card from your Bureau deck and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck afterwards.
Dialogue: "Last checked out to a Dave Duran." - Scully

name: Witness Intimidated
Text: Play on any Witness during your opponent's Investigation Phase. Pay X [CP] where X = the [RP] cost of the Witness. The Witness card is negated.

name: Women's Health Clinic
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
Dialogue: "If Anything should happen to me, or if we become separated, you must meet me here: 1255 91st St. Richville, M.D." - Note to Fox Mulder from Samantha Mulder

name: Women's Health Clinic, Richville, MD
Question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.

name: Work A Deal
Text: Played by itself, this card will negate one GOVERNMENT Adversary, discard both. If played on an Agent with the "Taped Intelligence" Equipment card attached, remove the "Taped Intelligence" card from the game and place this card in your Bureau section. As long as this card is in play, no GOVERNMENT Adversaries may be played on your Agents.

name: Writing on the Wall
Text: Attach this card to a Keyword MULTI Site to choose which prerequisite your opponent's Team must meet for this Site.
Dialogue: "What is a death omen if not a vision of our own mortality? And who among us would most likely be able to see the dead?" - Mulder

name: Written Report
Text: Play when an Agent is forced to return to the Bureau. Prior to moving, the Team may make a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check. If successful, the Agent does not have to return to the Bureau.

name: Written Report
Text: Play when an Agent is forced to return to the Bureau. Prior to moving, the Team may make a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check. If successful, the Agent does not have to return to the Bureau.

name: X
Text: Negate any one Keyword ADVERSARY card.

name: X
Text: Negate any one Keyword Adversary card.
Dialogue: "You still don't get it do you? The truth is still out there, but it's never been more dangerous. The man we both knew paid for that information with his life; a sacrifice I'm not willing to make." - X

name: X
Text: Negate any one Keyword ADVERSARY card.
Dialogue: "You failed. This is your success? Killing me? The truth is… you need me, Agent Mulder." - X

name: X's Demise Struggle
Text: Place this card on your opponent's side. While this card is in play, your opponent cannot use cards nor Agent's Game Effects that allow them to draw cards (or search for cards) from the Bureau deck or from the Discard Pile. During your Briefing Phase pay 1 [CP] or discard this card.
Dialogue: "I was warned by a man we both know… who I believe knows the truth…" - Scully

name: X-Files Research
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal, and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: ALIEN INVESTIGATION, OCCULT INVESTIGATION, or SCIENCES. This card may not be played on Agents Mulder or Scully. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: X-Files Research
Text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal, and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: ALIEN INVESTIGATION, OCCULT INVESTIGATION, or SCIENCES. This card may not be played on Agents Mulder or Scully. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: X-Terminated
Text: Play this card to negate one Keyword NEGATE card. If "X" is the negated card, it is removed from the game along with this card.
Dialogue: Mulder: "I feel like I came so close."Scully: "I feel it too. I know it."Mulder: "How?"Scully: "I was warned by a man we both know, who I believe knows the truth, who can lead us to a place to start."

name: Yaje
Text: You may place up to 2 [RP] from your Resource Pool on this card when it comes into play. Discard 1 [RP] token to double the [CP] Cost of any one OCCULT Adversary played by your opponent. If your opponent cannot or chooses not to pay the additional Cost, the Adversary card is discarded. When no tokens remain on this card, move it to your Discard Pile.
Dialogue: Mona Wustner: "What is that?Dr Bilac: "Vine of the soul."Wustner: "Yaje? You're drinking yaje? You're sick Lonnie. You need help."

name: Yankton Federal Prison, SD
Question: You may ask one METHOD question or one RESULT question. Add 2 [RP] to your [RP] pool if you successfully investigate this Site.
Dialogue: "Now that everyone is here, I will make my phone call. Now, who should I call? Should I call Mr. Strawberry?" - Mr. C

name: You see what I want you to see
Text: Discard two cards at random from your hand to negate any [CP] card played by your opponent. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.
Dialogue: "It's a false reality, Scully. Just like everything we've seen so far.'" - Mulder

name: You're A Dead Man
Text: Once this card is played, the investigating player may not play any Witnesses while investigating this Site, except for Witnesses which would specifically negate this card.

name: You've Got A Tail
Text: Play after a Team investigates a Site to destroy one Event RESOURCE.

name: You've Got A Tail
Text: Play after a Team investigates a Site to destroy one Event RESOURCE.

name: Your Last Warning
Text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one keyword GOVERNMENT Adversary.
Dialogue: The Grey-Haired Man: "You take your orders like those below you Mr Skinner. A case is made inactive, maybe that's because those above you have done the hard work of arriving at that decision."Skinner: "I'm gonna go now."The Grey-Haired Man: "It helps to know these things when a man looks forward to his career."

name: Yumi Sagiuchi Shultz
Game Effect: Place one token on this card. Discard a token to negate one Bluff or Event that forces an Agent on the Team to go to the Hospital.
Bio: Yumi Sagiuchi Shultz is violist for the Bergen Philharmonic Orchestra in Norway. She and her husband, Martin, encountered Agents Mulder and Scully during their investigation into several bizarre attacks by troll-like creatures.

name: Zelma's Palm Readings, North Minneapolis, MN
Question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
Dialogue: "The palms tell me all." - Madame Zelma

name: Zeus Storage, Maryland
Question: You may ask one METHOD question.
Dialogue: "All right, the number belongs to a company called Zeus Storage." - Pendrell

name: Éí 'Aaníígóó 'Áhoot'é
Text: Play to change a Site Prerequisite to ALIEN INVESTIGATION 3+.
Dialogue: "It looks like Navajo. It was used during World War II. My father told me that it was the only code the Japanese couldn't break." - Scully
